irish: Ní féidir a chruthú carachtar leis an ainm seo

english: Can't create a world with this name
irish: Ní féidir domhan a chruthú leis an ainm seo

english: There's already a save with the name $1 in the destination location.
irish: Níl cheana féin a shábháil leis an ainm $1 sa suíomh scríbe.
Cuir isteach IP nó cód cuireadh

english: Governs how often enemies may raid your base.
irish: Rialuithe cé chomh minic is féidir naimhde ruathar do bonn.

english: Do you have any bugs, cool ideas or general feedback you want to give us? Send us a message using this fancy mail button.
irish: An bhfuil fabhtanna, smaointe nó aiseolas ginearálta agat? Seol teachtaireacht chugainn leis an gcnaipe poist álainn seo.

english: Wood can catch fire and spread throughout the whole world, not just in the Ashlands.
irish: Is féidir le adhmad tine a ghabháil agus a scaipeadh ar fud an domhain ar fad, ní hamháin sa Ashlands.

english: Waiting for friend to start the game...
irish: Ag fanacht le haghaidh cara chun tús a chur leis an cluiche...

english: Please select the character you would like to use to join their game.
irish: Roghnaigh an carachtar ba mhaith leat a úsáid chun páirt a ghlacadh a gcluiche.

english: Some platform- or game features might not work correctly and the game might crash.
irish: D'fhéadfadh roinnt gnéithe ardán- nó cluiche ag obair i gceart agus d'fhéadfadh an cluiche tuairteála.
Copied cód páirt a ghlacadh chun clipboard!

english: You're about to join a different server.
irish: Tá tú ar tí a bheith ina fhreastalaí éagsúla.

english: Do you really want to kick '$1'?
irish: Ar mhaith leat i ndáiríre chun tús '$1'?

english: Please note that this file is currently kept in the old file structure which could cause sync conflicts and data loss. It will be moved to the Cloud on your next save. If you have disabled Cloud saves, it will be saved in the new non-synced folder. A local backup will always be kept when files are moved.
irish: Tabhair faoi deara go bhfuil an comhad a choimeád faoi láthair sa struchtúr comhad d'aois a d'fhéadfadh a bheith ina chúis coimhlintí sync agus caillteanas sonraí. Déanfar é a aistriú chuig an Cloud ar do shábháil eile. Má tá tú Sábhálann scamall faoi mhíchumas, beidh sé a shábháil san fhillteán nua neamh-sineite. Coimeádfar cúltaca áitiúil i gcónaí nuair a bhogtar comhaid.

english: If you prefer to keep the file in an un-synced local folder, use the <color=orange>Move to local</color> button. This is mainly recommended for dedicated servers, or if you wish to play in the same world with different accounts on the same computer. If you have manually disabled Cloud it will be moved to the new un-synced local folder.
irish: Más fearr leat a choinneáil ar an comhad i bhfillteán áitiúil un-synced, úsáid a bhaint as an líthir = oráiste . Téigh go dtí an cnaipe áitiúil / dath . Tá sé seo molta go príomha le haghaidh freastalaithe tiomanta, nó más mian leat a imirt ar an domhan céanna le cuntais éagsúla ar an ríomhaire céanna. Má tá tú faoi mhíchumas de láimh Cloud beidh sé ar athraíodh a ionad go dtí an fillteán áitiúil nua un-synced.

english: Make sure you are signed in to the platform you're playing on before trying to play online.
irish: Bí cinnte go bhfuil tú sínithe i go dtí an t-ardán atá tú ag imirt ar sula ag iarraidh a imirt ar líne.

english: Make sure you are signed in to Game Center before trying to play online. You may need to restart the game for changes to take effect.
irish: Bí cinnte go bhfuil tú sínithe i go dtí Ionad Cluiche sula ag iarraidh a imirt ar líne. Is féidir leat atosú an cluiche le haghaidh athruithe i bhfeidhm.

english: Could not log in to PlayFab.
irish: Níorbh fhéidir logáil isteach chun PlayFab.

english: Failed to log in. Please make sure you are connected to the Internet.
irish: Failed chun logáil isteach. Déan cinnte go bhfuil tú ceangailte leis an Idirlíon.
Logáil isteach chun seirbhís a chúlchur...

english: Valheim uses PlayFab to connect you with other players online. Sign in to PlayFab? This automatically creates an anonymous PlayFab account for you based on which platform you use to play on.
irish: Úsáideann Valheim PlayFab chun ceangal tú le himreoirí eile ar líne. Sínigh isteach chun PlayFab? Cruthaíonn sé seo go huathoibríoch cuntas PlayFab anaithnid ar do shon bunaithe ar a ardán a úsáideann tú a imirt ar.

english: Are you sure you want to log out of the current session?
irish: An bhfuil tú cinnte gur mhaith leat logáil amach as an seisiún reatha?

english: No disk space left - Exit anyway?
irish: Níl aon spás diosca fágtha - Exit anyway?

english: You do not have enough space left on the disk to save your game. Exit anyway? (Your world and character will NOT be saved!)
irish: Ní gá duit go leor spás fágtha ar an diosca a shábháil do chluiche. Téigh ar aon nós? (Ní bheidh do domhan agus carachtar a shábháil!)

english: You do not have enough space left on the disk to save your game. Please free up disk space and try saving again.
irish: Ní gá duit go leor spás fágtha ar an diosca a shábháil do chluiche. Le do thoil saor in aisce suas spás diosca agus iarracht a shábháil arís.

english: You are running out of disk space. Your game will be saved, but please consider freeing up disk space.
irish: Tá tú ag rith amach as spás diosca. Beidh do chluiche a shábháil, ach le do thoil a mheas freeing suas spás diosca.

english: This world save is missing its meta file. Would you like to restore it from the most recent backup?
irish: Tá an shábháil domhan ar iarraidh a comhad meta. Ar mhaith leat a chur ar ais ó na cúltaca is déanaí?

english:
You are playing a modded version of Valheim.
Please note that this may change the original game experience. If you are experiencing any issues, please first uninstall all mods before reporting it. If there has been a patch recently, some mods that previously worked may be broken until they are updated.
irish:
Tá leagan modáilte de Valheim á imirt agat.
Tabhair faoi deara go bhféadfadh sé seo taithí bunaidh an chluiche a athrú. Má tá fadhbanna agat, díshuiteáil gach mod ar dtús sula thuairiscíonn tú iad. Má tá paiste déanta le déanaí, d’fhéadfadh mods a bhí ag obair roimhe seo a bheith briste go dtí go ndéanfar iad a nuashonrú.

english: In casual mode combat is a lot easier, enemies will not attack you until provoked, and there are no raids on your base. Resources are more plentiful, and you will not drop items or lose skills on death.
irish: I troid modh ócáideach a lán níos éasca, ní bheidh naimhde ionsaí tú go dtí provoked, agus níl aon ruathair ar do bonn. Tá acmhainní níos flúirseach, agus ní bheidh tú míreanna titim nó scileanna a chailleadh ar bhás.

english: The way Valheim is meant to be played, with the intended difficulty balance. Highly recommended for your first playthrough for the best experience.
irish: Is é an bealach i gceist Valheim a bhí, leis an iarmhéid deacracht atá beartaithe. Moltar go mór do do chéad playthrough don taithí is fearr.

english: Combat is easier and there are fewer raids on your base.
irish: Tá Chomhrac níos éasca agus tá níos lú ruathair ar do bhonn.

english: In hammer mode you can build all build pieces for free once you have discovered the recipe. There are no raids on your base, and enemies will not attack you until provoked. Other difficulty settings are normal.
irish: I mód casúr is féidir leat a thógáil go léir píosaí a thógáil saor in aisce nuair a fuair tú amach an t-oideas. Níl aon ruathair ar do bonn, agus ní bheidh naimhde ionsaí tú go dtí provoked. Tá suímh deacrachta eile gnáth.

english: Combat is harder and monsters will raid your base more often.
irish: Tá Chomhrac níos deacra agus beidh arrachtaigh ruathar do bonn níos minice.

english: Combat is a lot harder and enemies will raid your base more often. When you die, all your skills and all the items you are carrying will be lost forever. You have no map and you may not use portals or exit boss dungeons while a boss is alive.
irish: Is Chomhrac a lán níos deacra agus beidh naimhde ruathar do bonn níos minice. Nuair a fhaigheann tú bás, beidh gach do chuid scileanna agus na míreanna go bhfuil tú ag iompar a bheith caillte go deo. Tá tú aon léarscáil agus ní féidir leat a úsáid tairseacha nó dungeons Bos scoir cé go bhfuil Bos beo.

english: In immersive mode you have no map, and you may not use portals. You will need to use your own wits to keep track of where you are in the world! Other difficulty settings are normal.
irish: I mód immersive nach bhfuil aon léarscáil agat, agus ní féidir leat tairseacha a úsáid. Beidh ort a bhaint as do chuid WITnna féin a choinneáil ar rian ar áit a bhfuil tú ar fud an domhain! Tá suímh deacrachta eile gnáth.

english: Normal is recommended on your first playthrough and is the most balanced overall.
irish: Tá Gnáth molta ar do chéad playthrough agus is é an chuid is mó cothrom foriomlán.

english: Please note that these settings can disrupt your Valheim experience. For your first playthrough, it is highly recommended that you play with the original settings. This way you'll get to play the game as it was meant to be played.
irish: Tabhair faoi deara gur féidir leis na suímh cur isteach ar do thaithí Valheim. I gcás do chéad playthrough, tá sé an-mholadh go bhfuil tú ag imirt leis na socruithe bunaidh. Ar an mbealach seo beidh tú a fháil a imirt ar an cluiche mar a bhí sé i gceist a imirt.
A domhan ainmnithe $ 1 ann cheana féin.
Níl an Tweet seo ar fáil

english: You will not be able to use portals or exit boss dungeons while a boss is active.
irish: Ní bheidh tú in ann a úsáid tairseacha nó dungeons Bos scoir agus tá Bos gníomhach.

english: Build pieces require no materials to build. You still need to discover recipes as per usual.
irish: Éilíonn píosaí tógála aon ábhar a thógáil. Ní mór duit fós oidis a fháil amach de réir mar is gnách.

english: You will not have access to the map or the minimap. This makes the game harder than intended.
irish: Ní bheidh rochtain agat ar an léarscáil nó ar an mionléarscáil. Déanann sé seo an cluiche níos deacra ná mar atá beartaithe.

english: You will not be able to use portals to teleport yourself across the world.
irish: Ní bheidh tú in ann a úsáid tairseacha a teleport féin ar fud an domhain.

english: Your platform account settings prevent you from accessing online multiplayer.
irish: Do suímh cuntas ardán cosc tú ó rochtain il-imreora ar líne.

english: You can only join servers running version $1.
irish: Is féidir leat a bheith páirteach ach freastalaithe ag rith leagan $1.

english: Enemies won't attack until you provoke them.
irish: Ní bheidh Enemies ionsaí go dtí go spreagfaidh tú iad.

english: Blocking this player will prevent you from playing together. This is in order to follow platform policies where you are not permitted to view User Generated Content (UGC) of blocked players. You will be disconnected, and will not be able to join any server they are playing on. Do you wish to proceed with blocking?
irish: Beidh blocála an imreoir a chosc tú ó imirt le chéile. Tá sé seo d'fhonn a leanúint beartais ardán i gcás nach bhfuil tú cead chun féachaint ar Ábhar Úsáideora Ginithe (UGC) na n-imreoirí blocked. Beidh tú a dhícheangal, agus ní bheidh sé in ann a bheith páirteach ar aon fhreastalaí bhfuil siad ag imirt ar. Ar mhaith leat dul ar aghaidh le blocáil?

english: Blocking this player will prevent you from playing together. As such, this action will kick the other player. Due to platform policies regarding User Generated Content (UGC), you will also be prevented from accessing this world for the duration of the block, meaning you will be logged out from the world as well. Do you wish to proceed with blocking?
irish: Beidh blocála an imreoir a chosc tú ó imirt le chéile. Mar sin, beidh an gníomh seo tús an t-imreoir eile. Mar gheall ar bheartais ardán maidir le Ábhar Úsáide Ginnithe (UGC), beidh tú a chosc freisin ó rochtain ar an saol seo ar feadh ré an bloc, rud a chiallaíonn go mbeidh tú a logáil amach as an domhan chomh maith. Ar mhaith leat dul ar aghaidh le blocáil?

english: Raids are based on the progress of each individual player, rather than on which bosses have been killed on the server. This setting is recommended if you want the game to be slightly friendlier to players with different progress.
irish: Tá Raids bunaithe ar dhul chun cinn gach imreoir aonair, seachas ar a bhfuil bosses maraíodh ar an bhfreastalaí. Tá an suíomh molta más mian leat an cluiche a bheith beagán friendlier le himreoirí le dul chun cinn éagsúla.

english: Changes how portals work in the game.
irish: Athruithe conas tairseacha ag obair sa chluiche.
Bain an chatagóir is fearr leat?

english: Oden's ravens forgot they told you about anything! You will get every unlocked hint once again.
irish: ravens Oden ar dearmad a dúirt siad leat faoi rud ar bith! Gheobhaidh tú gach leid unlocked arís.

english: Governs the amount of resources you gain from the world and from enemies.
irish: Rialaithe an méid na n-acmhainní a fhaigheann tú ón domhan agus ó naimhde.
Is é an comhad a shábháil truaillithe!

english: Beware that joining any online server will put your game character at risk. It might be a good idea to create a separate character when playing online to reduce the risk of losing precious possessions. Also be aware that there is always a risk of encountering cheaters and griefers when playing online. Good luck!
irish: Beware a cheanglaíonn aon fhreastalaí ar líne a chur do charachtar cluiche i mbaol. D'fhéadfadh sé a bheith ina smaoineamh maith a chruthú carachtar ar leith nuair a imirt ar líne a laghdú ar an mbaol a chailliúint sealúchais lómhara. Chomh maith leis sin a bheith ar an eolas go bhfuil i gcónaí i mbaol a bhíonn cheaters agus griefers nuair a imirt ar líne. Ádh mór!

english: This operation failed because save data storage is full. Please remove unused save data and try again.
irish: Theip ar an oibríocht seo toisc go bhfuil stóráil sonraí a shábháil iomlán. Bain úsáid as sonraí a shábháil agus déan iarracht arís.

english: Allows you to bring all items with you through portals for a more casual playstyle. This will circumvent the progression and exploration of the world as it is intended.
irish: Ceadaíonn tú a thabhairt ar gach mír a bhfuil tú trí thairseacha do playstyle níos ócáideach. Beidh sé seo circumvent an dul chun cinn agus taiscéalaíocht an domhain mar go bhfuil sé i gceist.

english: Please try again or restart the game if the problem persists.
irish: Déan iarracht arís nó atosú an cluiche má leanann an fhadhb.

english: Your platform privilege settings prevent you from viewing user generated content. Text from other players will be heavily filtered.
irish: Do suímh pribhléid ardán cosc tú ó féachana ábhar a ghintear úsáideoir. Beidh téacs ó imreoirí eile a scagadh go mór.

english: Valheim might crash on your system when using Vulkan
irish: D'fhéadfadh Valheim tuairteála ar do chóras nuair a úsáid Vulkan

english: You're currently using Vulkan. We're investigating a known crash when using Vulkan on certain systems, and your system has been detected as potentially being affected. If you experience stability issues, please use the default rendering API instead (DirectX 11). Sorry for the inconvenience!
irish: Tá tú ag baint úsáide as faoi láthair Vulkan. Táimid ag imscrúdú tuairteála ar eolas nuair a úsáid Vulkan ar chórais áirithe, agus tá do chóras a bhrath mar a d'fhéadfadh a bheith tionchar. Má bhíonn tú saincheisteanna cobhsaíochta, bain úsáid as an API réamhshocrú ionad (DirectX 11). Tá brón orainn don mhíchaoithiúlacht!

english: There is nothing new to copy
irish: Níl aon rud nua le cóipeáil

english: The bed must be placed under a roof
irish: Caithfear an leaba a chur faoi dhíon

english: The bed needs to be placed near a fire
irish: Caithfear an leaba a chur in aice le tine
Ní féidir leat níos mó $1 a chur leis

english: You can't consume that right now
irish: Ní féidir leat é sin a ithe anois
Ní féidir leat é sin a scaoileadh
Ní féidir leat é a oscailt
Ní féidir leat é sin a phiocadh suas

english: That can't be removed at this time
irish: Ní féidir é a bhaint anois

english: You can't sleep at this time

irish: Ní féidir leat $1 a úsáid ar $2

english: This cooking station is too weak for
irish: Tá an stáisiún cócaireachta ró-lag le haghaidh

english: Needs to be placed near the appropriate crafting station
irish: Caithfear é a chur in aice leis an stáisiún ceardaíochta cuí
Níl sé ag glacadh leis an mealladh

english: The bells are not in place

irish: Tá na Sinsear fós ina luí codlatach

english: You record your discoveries to the table
irish: Taifeadann tú d'aimsiúcháin ar an mbord

english: You copy some discoveries from the table
irish: Cóipeálann tú roinnt aimsiúchán ón mbord

english: You don't have the correct item

irish: Ní féidir an ceantar seo a oibriú

english: You need to have a lit fire below the cooking station
irish: Caithfear tine ar lasadh faoi stáisiún cócaireachta

english: A mystical force in this area stops you
irish: Cuireann fórsa misticiúil sa cheantar seo stop ort

english: You don't have any cookable items

irish: Ní féidir leat níos mó $1 a ithe

english: You don't have any processable items
An item prevents you from teleporting
irish: Cuireann earra cosc ort teilgean a dhéanamh

english: Can only be built inside a stone circle
irish: Ní féidir é a thógáil ach taobh istigh de chiorcal cloiche

english: Can't be placed in a dungeon
irish: Ní féidir é a chur i ndungeon

english: The crafting station needs a roof
irish: Teastaíonn díon ar an stáisiún ceardaíochta

english: The crafting station is too exposed
You throw some $1 into the fire
irish: Caitheann tú roinnt $1 isteach sa tine

english: The ballista is already loaded with
irish: Tá an balísteach luchtaithe cheana le

english: $1 refinement failed and broke on level $2
irish: Theip ar mhinicíocht $1 agus bhris sé ar leibhéal $2

english: Refining of $1 failed, downgraded to level $2
irish: Theip ar mhinicíocht $1, laghdú go leibhéal $2

english: The server does not have enough space left on disk to save your game.
irish: Níl go leor spáis ar dhiosca ag an bhfreastalaí chun do chluiche a shábháil.

english: Cloud storage full! World was moved to local storage and saved.
irish: Stóráil sa néal lán! Bogadh an domhan go stóráil áitiúil agus sábháladh é.

english: The server is running out of disk space, consider clearing up space to be able to save in the future.
irish: Tá an freastalaí ag rith amach as spás diosca, a mheas imréitigh suas spás a bheith in ann a shábháil sa todhchaí.

english: Can't be placed in this environment
irish: Ní féidir é a chur sa timpeallacht seo
Foinse do bhfianaise faoi stiúir glan
An t-eolas mícheart nó as dáta

english: You really shouldn't have done that!
irish: Ní mór duit i ndáiríre a bheith déanta go!
Feicfidh mé tú a fháil le haghaidh sin!

english: I'll feed you to a bloody asksvin!
irish: Feicfidh mé tú a beatha le fuilteacha asksvin!
Go dtí an chéad uair eile.
Féach tú timpeall. Nó nach bhfuil.

english: A living person, huh? That's a nice change of pace.
irish: Duine beo, huh? Sin athrú deas de luas.
An bhfuil tú cara nó fóe?

english: That's a good way to get yourself thrown into the lava.
irish: Sin bealach maith a fháil duit féin thrown isteach sa lava.

english: I really wouldn't do that if I were you.
irish: Ní ba mhaith liom a dhéanamh i ndáiríre go má bhí mé tú.

english: I think I'm going to sweat my beard off.
irish: I mo thuairimse, tá mé ag dul a sweat mo féasóg as.

english: I could really use a mug of cold ale right now...
irish: D'fhéadfadh mé a úsáid i ndáiríre mug de ale fuar ceart anois...

english: When you think about it, this heat isn't worse than the heat from a good forge.
irish: Nuair a cheapann tú faoi, nach bhfuil an teas níos measa ná an teas ó bhrionnú maith.

english: Don't forget to wipe off that sweat! Or else a morgen might smell you and decide you're its dinner.
irish: Ná déan dearmad a wipe amach go sweat! Nó eile a d'fhéadfadh morgen boladh tú, agus cinneadh a dhéanamh go bhfuil tú a dinnéar.
Fuilchloch, cloch fola, cloch fola, cloch fola...

english: Be careful if you see a big pile of bones. It usually means one of those morgen creatures is nearby.
irish: Bí cúramach má fheiceann tú carn mór cnámha. Ciallaíonn sé de ghnáth ar cheann de na créatúir morgen in aice láimhe.

english: Those undead bastards sure hoard some pretty gemstones...
irish: Na bastairdí undead cinnte hoard roinnt gemstones go leor...

english: This place is astonishing! So much land still to explore!
irish: Tá an áit astonishing! An oiread talún fós chun iniúchadh a dhéanamh!

english: It may be warm, but the discoveries we make are their own reward.
irish: D'fhéadfadh sé a bheith te, ach tá na fionnachtana a dhéanann muid a gcuid luaíocht féin.

english: Ha! A Whitebeard would never dare to venture here.
irish: Bhí! Ní bheadh Whitebeard dare chun fiontair anseo.

english: The Whitebeards could never withstand this heat. They just don't have the stones for it!
irish: Níorbh fhéidir leis na Whitebeards an teas seo a sheasamh. Níl siad ach na clocha chun é!

english: I was made for dwelling below ground, among the cool rocks. Not this blistering heat.
irish: Rinneadh mé le haghaidh cónaithe faoi thalamh, i measc na carraigeacha fionnuar. Gan an teas blistering seo.

english: I came upon a ruin with a whole flock of asksvin yesterday! They were there to search for food, methinks.
irish: Tháinig mé ar ruin le tréad iomlán de asksvin inné! Bhí siad ann chun cuardach a dhéanamh ar bhia, methinks.

english: Careful, even the water here is boiling hot.
irish: Cúramach, fiú an t-uisce anseo fiuchphointe te.

english: My cousin is stationed in the lands of fog. Lucky Whitebeard...
irish: Tá mo chol ceathrair lonnaithe i dtailte ceo. cliceáil grianghraf a mhéadú

english: I wonder if there's any shade around here. Not that it'd help...
irish: N'fheadar má tá aon scáth timpeall anseo. Gan gur mhaith leis cabhrú...
Hm. Boladh cosúil le uibheacha rotten.

english: Mind your step. My brother lost a toe to the lava a while back.
irish: Mind do chéim. Chaill mo dheartháir ladhar go dtí an lava ar ais.

english: My sister tried to tame an asksvin, you know. It bit off her hand, even though they don't even eat meat!
irish: Mo dheirfiúr iarracht a tame ar asksvin, tá a fhios agat. giotán sé as a lámh, cé nach bhfuil siad ag ithe fiú feoil!

english: Vineberries, vineberries... I know I saw some around here...
irish: Sútha talún, fíniúnacha... Tá a fhios agam chonaic mé roinnt timpeall anseo...

english: I should never have bet on that dice game...
irish: Ba chóir dom riamh geall ar an cluiche dísle...

english: I've been thinking of getting a pet. It would be nice, don't you think?
irish: Tá mé ag smaoineamh ar a fháil peataí. Bheadh sé deas, ná cheapann tú?

english: A bit of sweat is good for you, my mother always said!
irish: Tá beagán de sweat maith ar do shon, a dúirt mo mháthair i gcónaí!
Bhí an t-eolas mícheart nó as dáta

english: I hope the children are doing alright back home. It's been so long now since I last saw them...
irish: Tá súil agam go bhfuil na páistí ag déanamh ar ais sa bhaile. Tá sé chomh fada anois ó chonaic mé go deireanach iad...

english: When we get back home I think I'm going to pick up a new hobby.
irish: Nuair a fhaigheann muid ar ais sa bhaile I mo thuairimse, tá mé ag dul a phiocadh suas caitheamh aimsire nua.

english: I think my boot needs mending.
irish: I mo thuairimse, riachtanais mo tosaithe mending.

english: Ah, to feel the cool relief of mist on my face... I was a fool to leave that post behind.
irish: Ah, a bhraitheann an faoiseamh fionnuar de olc ar mo aghaidh... Bhí mé amadán a fhágáil go post taobh thiar.

english: I wonder what discoveries tomorrow will bring. Those Whitebeards don't know what they're missing!
irish: N'fheadar cad fionnachtana amárach a thabhairt. Níl a fhios ag na Whitebeards cad tá siad ar iarraidh!

english: I could never remain stationed at just one excavation for months. Us Redbeards are meant to explore!
irish: Níorbh fhéidir liom fanacht lonnaithe ag tochailt amháin ar feadh míonna. Linn Redbeards i gceist chun iniúchadh a dhéanamh!

english: The Whitebeards will be jealous when they hear of our success, I'm sure!
irish: Beidh na Whitebeards a bheith éad nuair a chloiseann siad ár rath, tá mé cinnte!

english: Then again, the heat isn't too bad!
irish: Ansin arís, níl an teas ró-dona!

english: I don't care much for those smokepuff mushrooms myself. Only fit for asksvin food, really!
irish: Ní féidir liom cúram i bhfad do na beacáin smokepuff féin. Ach oiriúnach le haghaidh bia asksvin, i ndáiríre!

english: I saw someone run around in just their underpants and some belts, seemed nice and cool...
irish: Chonaic mé duine éigin ar siúl timpeall i díreach a n-pants agus roinnt criosanna, an chuma deas agus cool...

english: Those siblings had the right idea. Imagine being off on your very own business venture in a cool forest!
irish: Bhí na deartháireacha an smaoineamh ceart. Samhlaigh a bheith as ar do fiontar gnó an-féin i foraoise fionnuar!

english: I wonder what we'll find out here. Surely it must be worth it.
irish: N'fheadar cad a fheicfidh muid amach anseo. Surely ní mór é a bheith fiú é.

english: I wish I could have a nice, cool bath.
irish: Is mian liom go raibh folctha deas, fionnuar agam.

english: What do you suppose we'll find out here?
irish: Cad a dhéanann tú dócha go mbainfidh muid amach anseo?

english: We sure hit those charred hard yesterday, didn't we?
irish: Táimid bhuail cinnte iad siúd charred crua inné, ní raibh muid?

english: They used to worship the Emerald Flame in these parts. Makes you wonder what kind of patron that is...
irish: D'úsáid siad chun adhradh an Flame Emerald sna codanna. Déanann tú Wonder cén cineál pátrún atá...

english: Don't worry about me, I'll be fine without you.
irish: Ná bíodh imní ort faoi dom, beidh mé fíneáil gan tú.

english: I suppose I'll find my own way out.
irish: Is dócha go mbainfidh mé teacht ar mo bhealach féin amach.

english: Slay all the giantkind you can!
irish: Slay go léir an giantkind is féidir leat!
Go dtí go chéile againn arís, ansin.
Tá mé go dtí seo ó bhaile...
An bhfuil tú cara nó fóe?

english: Help me get out of here!
irish: Cabhair dom a fháil amach anseo!

english: I'll help you if you help me.
irish: Beidh mé cabhrú leat má tá tú cabhrú liom.

english: I'll show you what magic can do!
irish: Feicfidh mé a thaispeáint duit cad is féidir draíochta a dhéanamh!
Ní féidir Oden cabhrú leat anois!

english: You really shouldn't have done that!
irish: Ní mór duit i ndáiríre a bheith déanta go!

english: The boiled pork has been fried now, alright!
irish: Tá an muiceoil bruite friochta anois, ceart!

english: I'll teach you not to mess with us!
irish: Beidh mé ag múineadh tú gan praiseach le linn!

english: I'll send you to where the pipe bends!
irish: Feicfidh mé tú a sheoladh chuig nuair a Bends an píopa!

english: Always watch out for the gjall.
irish: Féach i gcónaí amach le haghaidh an gjall.

english: Maybe we'll meet again, maybe not.
irish: B'fhéidir go mbainfidh muid le chéile arís, b'fhéidir nach bhfuil.
Tá tú níos airde ná cuimhin liom.

english: So you're the one who's been causing such a ruckus.
irish: Mar sin, tá tú an ceann atá ag cúis ruckus den sórt sin.

english: Hello. You've travelled a long way.
irish: Dia duit. Tá tú ag taisteal ar bhealach fada.
Níl aon cheann de sin, stop a chur leis!

english: We're only good hosts as long as you're a good guest.
irish: Tá muid ach hóstach maith chomh fada agus go bhfuil tú aoi maith.

english: You're close to overstaying your welcome, Norseman.
irish: Tá tú gar do overcoming do fáilte, Norseman.

english: If you do that again, you won't like what happens.
irish: Má dhéanann tú sin arís, ní bheidh tú mhaith cad a tharlaíonn.

english: I hope this mine isn't as infested as the last.
irish: Tá súil agam nach bhfuil an mianach mar infested mar an ceann deireanach.

english: Is it true that there's no magic in Midgard?
irish: An bhfuil sé fíor nach bhfuil aon draíocht i Midgard?

english: I wonder if we can bring this shipment home soon.
irish: N'fheadar más féidir linn an teach loingsiú a thabhairt go luath.

english: Do you ever wonder what happened to Haldor?
irish: An bhfuil tú riamh Wonder cad a tharla do Haldor?

english: Those seekers are not to be messed with...
irish: Níl na hiarrthóirí a bheith messed le...

english: I remember yet, the giants of yore...
irish: Is cuimhin liom go fóill, na giants de yore...

english: We built these mines, you know? And now look at us...
irish: Thóg muid na mianaigh, tá a fhios agat? Agus anois breathnú ar orainn...

english: These pests have spread further than I feared. At this rate, all our old mines will be overtaken.
irish: Tá na lotnaidí seo scaipthe níos faide ná mar a bhí eagla orm. Ag an ráta seo, beidh ár mianaigh d'aois a overtaken.

english: It must be strange, being human. Imagine having to crawl through small spaces!
irish: Caithfidh sé a bheith aisteach, a bheith daonna. Samhlaigh a bhfuil a crawl trí spásanna beaga!

english: I hope this mine isn't as infested as the last.
irish: Tá súil agam nach bhfuil an mianach mar infested mar an ceann deireanach.

english: It's damp as a troll's armpit here, but at least it's not as painfully hot as the south.
irish: Tá sé taise mar armpit troll ar anseo, ach ar a laghad nach bhfuil sé chomh painfully te mar an taobh ó dheas.

english: I wonder if we can bring this shipment home soon.
irish: N'fheadar más féidir linn an teach loingsiú a thabhairt go luath.

english: We built these mines, you know? And now look at us...
irish: Thóg muid na mianaigh, tá a fhios agat? Agus anois breathnú ar orainn...

english: Do you ever wonder what happened to Haldor?
irish: An bhfuil tú riamh Wonder cad a tharla do Haldor?

english: Sometimes I wonder if the eitr is worth all of this.
irish: Uaireanta N'fheadar má tá an eitéar fiú gach ceann de seo.

english: I look forward to seeing what the fire will show me next.
irish: Táim ag tnúth le féachaint ar cad a bheidh an tine a thaispeáint dom seo chugainn.

english: Now where did I put that bottle...?
irish: Anois, nuair a chuir mé an buidéal sin...?

english: I swear we had a spare Extractor here somewhere...
irish: I swear bhí againn Extractor spártha anseo áit éigin...

english: Just a bit more of this mining, and then we can take it back to Myrkheim.
irish: Just a beagán níos mó den mhianadóireacht, agus ansin is féidir linn é a chur ar ais go dtí Myrkheim.
Feicfidh mé a dhéanamh bleed tú!
Tá tú curtha do turnip deiridh!

english: Enjoying shooting yourself in the foot, eh? I can help with that!
irish: Bain sult as lámhach tú féin sa chos, eh? Is féidir liom cabhrú leis sin!

english: So it's a fight you're after, then?
irish: Mar sin, tá sé ina troid go bhfuil tú tar éis, ansin?

english: I'll mop the floors with your guts!
irish: Beidh mé mop na hurláir le do inní!
Go dtí an chéad uair eile.

english: Keep that wisplight close, you don't want to lose it.
irish: Coinnigh go wisplight gar, nach bhfuil tú ag iarraidh a chailleadh.

english: I wouldn't do that if I were you.
irish: Ní ba mhaith liom a dhéanamh go má bhí mé tú.

english: Touch that again and I'll chop your hand off.
irish: Dteagmháil go arís agus beidh mé chop do lámh as.

english: We're not to be trifled with!
irish: Níl muid a bheith trifled le!

english: You'd best be real careful. Or things will go badly for you.
irish: Ba mhaith leat a bheith is fearr fíor cúramach. Nó beidh rudaí dul go dona ar do shon.

english: You never know what you'll find out there in the mist.
irish: Níl a fhios agat cad beidh tú a fháil amach ann sa mist.

english: If we could come through to here, it makes you wonder what else might...
irish: Má d'fhéadfadh muid teacht tríd go dtí anseo, a dhéanann sé Wonder tú cad eile a d'fhéadfadh...
Is fearr a bheith ar do garda.

english: What's Midgard like, then? I've only ever heard the tales.
irish: Cad é Midgard mhaith, ansin? Chuala mé ach na scéalta riamh.

english: Do all humans look like you? You're so... Nevermind.
irish: An bhfuil gach duine cuma mhaith leat? Tá tú mar sin... Nevermind.

english: It's easy to lose track of the days out here...
irish: Tá sé éasca a chailleadh rian de na laethanta amach anseo...

english: Us dvergr watch out for our own kin.
irish: Linn dvergr faire amach le haghaidh ár kin féin.

english: Blasted seekers! I wish they'd all just shrivel up and die.
irish: Iarrthóirí Blasted! Is mian liom gur mhaith leo go léir ach shrivel suas agus bás.

english: I almost got completely drained by a tick once... But dvergr don't die that easily.
irish: Fuair mé beagnach draenáilte go hiomlán ag tic uair amháin... Ach nach bhfuil dvergr bás go héasca.

english: It's a bit strange to think this was all once a great battlefield...
irish: Tá sé beagán aisteach chun smaoineamh go raibh sé seo go léir uair amháin catha mór...

english: My knees are aching, but at least we have food and a warm fire.
irish: Tá mo ghlúine aching, ach ar a laghad ní mór dúinn bia agus tine te.

english: I heard we're venturing down south again. Maybe I'll apply for the expedition this time.
irish: Chuala mé go bhfuil muid ag venturing síos ó dheas arís. B'fhéidir go mbainfidh mé iarratas ar an expedition an uair seo.

english: If you work and keep tidy, Friday brings money.
irish: Má tá tú ag obair agus a choinneáil slachtmhar, tugann Dé hAoine airgead.

english: This little fort is nothing compared to our strongholds at home...
irish: Is é seo an fort beag aon rud i gcomparáid lenár láidreacht sa bhaile...

english: When is it dinner time? I'm hungry.
irish: Cathain a bhfuil sé am dinnéar? Tá mé ocras.

english: Are we running out of ale? I think we're running out of ale...
irish: An bhfuil muid ag rith amach as ale? Sílim go bhfuil muid ag rith amach as ale...

english: Some repairs to this place wouldn't hurt.
irish: Ní bheadh roinnt deisiúcháin ar an áit seo Gortaítear.

english: I don't get why they didn't just take everything when they left the mines. Why leave the cores there?
irish: Ní féidir liom a fháil cén fáth nach raibh siad a ghlacadh ach gach rud nuair a d'fhág siad na mianaigh. Cén fáth a fhágann na cores ann?

english: Damned seekers smashed our black cores! Back into the deep then, I guess...
irish: Iarrthóirí damáiste smashed ár cores dubh! Ar ais isteach sa domhain ansin, buille faoi thuairim mé...

english: This world has changed so much since our people were here last. Imagine what it'll look like in another couple of centuries!
irish: Tá an domhan athrú an oiread sin ó bhí ár ndaoine anseo seo caite. Samhlaigh cad beidh sé cuma mhaith i gceann eile cúpla céad bliain!

english: Thanks, but I don't need that.
irish: Go raibh maith agat, ach ní gá dom go.

english: I'm gonna have to say... no.
irish: Tá mé gonna a rá... Níl.

english: A definite no on that one.
irish: Cinnte aon ar an gceann sin.
Go raibh maith agat ach níl.

english: Not sure what I'd do with that.
irish: Ní cinnte cad ba mhaith liom a dhéanamh leis sin.

english: I wouldn't touch that with a ten foot iron beam.
irish: Ní ba mhaith liom teagmháil a dhéanamh le bhíoma iarann deich troigh.

english: That's not what I'm looking for.
irish: Nach bhfuil cad tá mé ag lorg.

english: You can do better than that.
irish: Is féidir leat a dhéanamh níos fearr ná sin.

english: I think you misunderstood my needs.
irish: I mo thuairimse, misunderstood tú mo chuid riachtanas.

english: These are fine items, not the sort of things you can just pick up.
irish: Tá na míreanna fíneáil, nach bhfuil an saghas rudaí is féidir leat a phiocadh ach suas.

english: Don't touch anything unless you're prepared to pay for it.
irish: Ná dteagmháil le rud ar bith mura bhfuil tú sásta a íoc as é.

english: Cast your eyes over my goods but keep your hands to yourself.
irish: Réitigh do shúile thar mo earraí ach a choinneáil do lámha duit féin.

english: Something here might keep you alive a little longer. Though I don't know why you'd bother.
irish: D'fhéadfadh rud éigin anseo a choinneáil beo tú beagán níos faide. Cé nach bhfuil a fhios agam cén fáth gur mhaith leat bodhraigh.

english: Try not to wander too far. I want your things when you get killed.
irish: Bain triail as gan wander i bhfad ró-. Ba mhaith liom do chuid rudaí nuair a fhaigheann tú maraíodh.

english: Away with you. I have things to do.
irish: Away leat. Tá mé rudaí a dhéanamh.

english: Humph! Another scrap of flesh from the Valkyries...
irish: Mol! Eile scrap de flesh ó na Valkyries...

english: Happy to do business with you.
Welcome to my neck of the woods, as it were.
irish: Fáilte go dtí mo mhuineál na coillte, mar a bhí sé.

english: Take a look at my wares.
I'm sure I've got what you need.
irish: Tá mé cinnte mé fuair cad is gá duit.

english: I've got a little bit of everything.
irish: Tá mé fuair beagán de gach rud.

english: My wares aren't exactly bespoke, but they'll do the job.
irish: Níl mo wares bespoke go díreach, ach beidh siad a dhéanamh ar an bpost.
Tá mé gearr le haghaidh dwarf.

english: What are you looking at? Have you never seen a dwarf before?
irish: Cad atá á lorg agat? An bhfaca tú dwarf riamh roimhe seo?

english: Mining is just so boring! Fortunately I come from a family of entrepreneurs.
irish: Is Mining díreach leadránach sin! Fortunately tháinig mé ó theaghlach na bhfiontraithe.

english: I don't really go in for the fancy stuff, that's my sister's area of expertise.
irish: Ní féidir liom dul i ndáiríre i do na stuif mhaisiúil, go bhfuil mo dheirfiúr réimse saineolais.

english: Let's see what scraps you've picked up...
irish: A ligean ar a fheiceáil cad iad na scraps atá tú phiocadh suas...

english: I wonder if anything sparkles amongst all this muck you carry...
irish: N'fheadar má sparkles rud ar bith i measc seo go léir a dhéanann tú...

english: We're all lost here. The Gods turned their eyes from Valheim a long time ago.
irish: Táimid caillte go léir anseo. Na Dia iompú a súile ó Valheim ar feadh i bhfad ó shin.

english: I suppose you're here to hunt the Forsaken Ones? I don't bother them and they don't bother me.
irish: Is dócha go bhfuil tú anseo chun fiach na cinn Forsaken? Ní féidir liom bodhraigh iad agus nach bhfuil siad bodhraigh dom.

english: Fight, build, explore. It all ends in the grave.
irish: An comhrac, a thógáil, iniúchadh. Críochnaíonn sé go léir sa uaigh.

english: You're no different to all the others that came before you, warrior. And you'll end the same way.
irish: Tá tú aon éagsúla do na daoine eile a tháinig roimh tú, laoch. Agus beidh tú deireadh ar an mbealach céanna.

english: Commerce is the only thing that separates us from the beasts.
irish: Is é an tráchtáil an rud amháin a scarann chugainn ó na beithigh.

english: I'm interested in trade, not chatter. Do you want to buy something or not?
irish: Tá suim agam i dtrádáil, ní chatter. Ar mhaith leat rud éigin a cheannach nó nach ea?

english: Come, let us make a deal.
You're fortunate to have caught me in a good mood. Let us trade.
irish: Tá tú ádh a bheith gafa dom i giúmar maith. Lig dúinn trádáil.

english: Yay, you found it! Now check out my wares!
irish: Yay, fuair tú é! Anois seiceáil amach mo wares!

english: That one must have been a challenge, but you won't regret it!
irish: Ní mór an duine sin a bheith ina dhúshlán, ach ní bheidh tú brón air!

english: I didn't think you would manage that one. Colour me impressed!
irish: Ní raibh mé ag smaoineamh go mbeadh tú a bhainistiú go ceann. Dath mé tógtha!
Tá tú a tugadh cheana féin dom go.

english: Nice replica. It's not mine though.
irish: macasamhail Nice. Níl sé mianach cé.

english: Keep it. I have no use for that.
irish: Coinnigh é. Níl aon úsáid agam sin.

english: But...you already gave me this chest. Where did you get this?
irish: Ach... thug tú dom an cófra seo cheana féin. Cá bhfuair tú é seo?

english: That's...not mine. I guess someone really just likes my style, huh?
irish: Sin...Ní mianach. Buille faoi thuairim mé duine éigin i ndáiríre maith ach mo stíl, huh?

english: Thanks for the help, I really appreciate it. There's still more of my stuff out there though, if you have time.
irish: Go raibh maith agat as an cabhair, Is mór agam i ndáiríre é. Níl fós níos mó de mo stuif amach ann cé, má tá tú am.

english: You know, this place was more peaceful in the past. A lady could travel here without being robbed of all her things.
irish: Tá a fhios agat, bhí an áit seo níos síochánta san am atá caite. D'fhéadfadh a bhean taisteal anseo gan a bheith robbed ar a cuid rudaí.

english: It's nice to have some of my stock back. But I really would appreciate it if I could get all of it.
irish: Tá sé deas go bhfuil roinnt de mo stoc ar ais. Ach ba mhaith liom a thuiscint i ndáiríre é má raibh mé in ann a fháil ar fad é.

english: It's not too much trouble, right? To find my stolen things. It's really sweet of you to help.
irish: Níl sé an iomarca trioblóide, ceart? Chun teacht ar mo rudaí a goideadh. Tá sé i ndáiríre milis de tú chun cabhrú.

english: The big lox is Hallon and the small one is Blåbär.
irish: Is é an lox mór Hallon agus is é an ceann beag Blåbär.

english: She warned me it wasn't a good idea to go here... But I went anyway, and now part of my stock is rotting away in some dungeon.
irish: Rabhadh sí dom nach raibh sé smaoineamh maith chun dul anseo... Ach chuaigh mé ar aon nós, agus anois tá cuid de mo stoc ag lobhadh ar shiúl i roinnt dungeon.

english: There are rumours about you, you know? I wonder if they match reality.
irish: Tá ráflaí faoi tú, tá a fhios agat? N'fheadar má mheaitseáil siad réaltacht.

english: Making progress, I hope? I have this fabric I'd love to see on you, but I'd need you to bring it back first.
irish: Ag déanamh dul chun cinn, tá súil agam? Tá mé an fabraic ba mhaith liom grá a fheiceáil ar tú, ach ba mhaith liom gá duit a thabhairt ar ais ar dtús.

english: It's nice that the shop isn't entirely empty anymore, at least.
irish: Tá sé deas nach bhfuil an siopa folamh go hiomlán níos mó, ar a laghad.

english: Ooh, that'll look great on you!
irish: Ooh, go mbainfidh cuma iontach ar tú!

english: That's one of my finest works.
irish: Sin ceann de mo oibreacha is fearr.

english: I had a lot of fun making this.
irish: Bhí mé a lán de spraoi a dhéanamh seo.

english: See you again soon, I hope!
irish: Féach tú arís go luath, Tá súil agam!

english: I'll be here a while, in case you're in need of anything else.
irish: Beidh mé a bheith anseo ar feadh tamaill, i gcás go bhfuil tú i gá aon rud eile.

english: Welcome to my shop. It's a tad bit more elegant than my brother's.
irish: Fáilte go dtí mo siopa. Tá sé beagán níos galánta ná mo dheartháir.

english: You look like your wardrobe could do with a bit of an upgrade.
irish: Tá tú ag breathnú cosúil d'fhéadfadh do wardrobe a dhéanamh le beagán de uasghrádú.

english: Well, well, girls, look what the neck dragged in.
irish: Bhuel, go maith, cailíní, breathnú ar an muineál dragged i.

english: Almost all of my wares, stolen! What use is a shop if it doesn't even have anything to sell?
irish: Beagnach gach ceann de mo wares, goideadh! Cén úsáid a bhaint as siopa más rud é nach bhfuil sé fiú aon rud a dhíol?

english: Don't try to open the chests yourself if you find them. Dwarven locks can't be picked, and the chests themselves could withstand an explosion...
irish: Ná déan iarracht a oscailt na cófraí féin má fhaigheann tú iad. Ní féidir glais dwarf a phiocadh, agus d'fhéadfadh na cófraí iad féin a sheasamh le pléascadh...

english: Do you know how frustrating it is to have so much hard work just... stolen from you?
irish: An bhfuil a fhios agat conas frustrating go bhfuil sé an oiread sin oibre crua díreach... goidte ó tú?

english: I'll sell you what I have at a discount, if you just get my things back to me. Like a finder's fee.
irish: Feicfidh mé a dhíol tú cad tá mé ar lascaine, má tá tú a fháil ach mo rudaí ar ais chugam. Cosúil le táille an aimsitheora.

english: Bring my chests back to me when you find them. I'll unlock them and we can do good business.
irish: Tabhair mo cófraí ar ais chugam nuair a fhaigheann tú iad. Feicfidh mé dhíghlasáil iad agus is féidir linn a dhéanamh gnó maith.

english: Don't even think about keeping the chests to yourself, now that you know where they are. You can't open them without the right key.
irish: Ná fiú smaoineamh ar na cófraí a choinneáil duit féin, anois go bhfuil a fhios agat cá bhfuil siad. Ní féidir leat iad a oscailt gan an eochair cheart.

english: Most of my stuff was stolen from me. I've marked out where it was on the map, in case you'd like to help me look for it.
irish: Goideadh an chuid is mó de mo stuif uaim. Tá mé marcáilte amach nuair a bhí sé ar an léarscáil, i gcás gur mhaith leat chun cabhrú liom breathnú ar sé.

english: If you'd help me get some things back, I'd be happy to do business with you.
irish: Más mian leat cabhrú liom a fháil ar roinnt rudaí ar ais, Ba mhaith liom a bheith sásta gnó a dhéanamh leat.

english: I'd go get my things back myself, but I'm not willing to risk losing anything else. Help a girl out?
irish: Ba mhaith liom dul a fháil ar mo rudaí ar ais mé féin, ach níl mé sásta a chailliúint riosca rud ar bith eile. Cabhair le cailín amach?

english: I got away, but my goods weren't so lucky. At least I know where it happened, whatever good that does me.
irish: Fuair mé ar shiúl, ach ní raibh mo earraí chomh-ádh. Ar a laghad tá a fhios agam nuair a tharla sé, is cuma cad maith a dhéanann dom.

english: That's where they ambushed me, the greedy little bastards. You wouldn't want to go after them for me, would you?
irish: Sin an áit a inmbushed siad dom, an bastards beag greedy. Ní bheadh tú ag iarraidh dul i ndiaidh dóibh dom, bheadh tú?
Cinnte, beidh mé é a ghlacadh.

english: Hm, I might be able to use that for something.
irish: Hm, D'fhéadfadh mé a bheith in ann é sin a úsáid le haghaidh rud éigin.

english: You know what they say, one person's trash is another one's treasure.
irish: Tá a fhios agat cad a deir siad, tá duine amháin bruscar ceann eile Treasure.

english: Why not? I'm sure I can pawn that off at some point.
irish: Cén fáth nach bhfuil? Tá mé cinnte gur féidir liom a geallearbadh go amach ag pointe éigin.

english: Take a look, why don't you?
irish: Féach, cén fáth nach bhfuil tú?

english: I'm sure I've got something that'll tickle your fancy.
irish: Tá mé cinnte mé fuair rud éigin go mbainfidh tickle do mhaisiúil.

english: If you're looking for worms and eggs, you've come to the wrong shop.
irish: Má tá tú ag lorg worms agus uibheacha, tá tú ag teacht ar an siopa mícheart.

english: Let me know if you find anything you like!
irish: Lig dom a fhios má fhaigheann tú rud ar bith is mian leat!

english: My wares are made out of the finest cloth.
irish: Mo wares atá déanta as an éadach is fearr.

english: You'll only find products of the highest quality in my shop, I assure you.
irish: Feicfidh tú ach táirgí den chaighdeán is airde i mo siopa, Dearbhaím duit.

english: It's okay, you can pet the lox if you want.
irish: Tá sé ceart go leor, is féidir leat peataí an lox más mian leat.

english: As fun as these sojourns are, it'll be nice to get back home to my kin.
irish: Mar spraoi mar go bhfuil na sojourns, beidh sé deas a fháil ar ais sa bhaile le mo kin.

english: You know, this place was more peaceful in the past. A lady could travel here without being robbed of all her things.
irish: Tá a fhios agat, bhí an áit seo níos síochánta san am atá caite. D'fhéadfadh a bhean taisteal anseo gan a bheith robbed ar a cuid rudaí.

english: The big lox is Hallon and the small one is Blåbär.
irish: Is é an lox mór Hallon agus is é an ceann beag Blåbär.

english: The wagon's off limits, sorry. A girl's gotta keep some trade secrets to herself.
irish: Teorainneacha an vaigíní, tá brón orm. A cailín gotta a choinneáil ar roinnt rúin trádála di féin.

english: There are rumours about you, you know? I wonder if they match reality.
irish: Tá ráflaí faoi tú, tá a fhios agat? N'fheadar má mheaitseáil siad réaltacht.

english: Hm... I'd love to tailor you a custom piece sometime.
irish: Hm... Ba mhaith liom grá a chur in oiriúint duit píosa saincheaptha éigin.

english: Back in the day I thought about setting up shop here permanently. But there aren't really enough customers for that.
irish: Ar ais sa lá a shíl mé faoi bhunú siopa anseo go buan. Ach nach bhfuil i ndáiríre go leor custaiméirí don.

english: This place isn't too bad, all things considered. Maybe I'll bring someone else along next time.
irish: Níl an áit seo ró-dona, gach rud a mheas. B'fhéidir go mbainfidh mé duine éigin eile a thabhairt chomh maith an chéad uair eile.

english: Kraa! A sad memory lingers here... A faint echo in the air... Once these rang for joy to celebrate his passing but now he cannot bear the sound nor the reminder. If you seek to bring him give them voice once more.
irish: Kraa! A lingers cuimhne brónach anseo... A macalla faint san aer... Chomh luath agus na ghlao seo le haghaidh áthas chun ceiliúradh a rith ach anois ní féidir leis an fhuaim ná an gcuimhne. Má fhéachann tú a thabhairt dó guth a thabhairt dóibh uair amháin níos mó.

english: Kraa! Poor pickings here. Empty skulls scoured clean by the flames. Barely a trace of memory left…
irish: Kraa! Piocaí Poor anseo. skulls folamh scoured glan ag na lasracha. Barely rian de chuimhne fágtha...

english: Well met little swordling! Look around you this is the Waste of the Emerald Flame… This is the end of all pride the fire that consumes itself… Tread carefully!
irish: Bhuel bhuail claíomh beag! Féach timpeall ort é seo an Dramhaíola an Flame Emerald... Is é seo an deireadh gach bród an tine a itheann féin... Arán go cúramach!

english: Kraa! I bring a message from the Allfather. Honor is forged in flame. Strike hard upon the anvil spare not the steel!
irish: Kraa! Tugaim teachtaireacht ón Uileathair. Tá Honor brionnaithe i lasair. Stailc crua ar an spártha anvil nach bhfuil an cruach!

english: Kraahaha! A fellow carrion bird! Look at you picking over these poor dead remains…
irish: Cóipeáil nasc leis an tweet éan cairéad eile! Féach ar tú ag piocadh thar na hiarsmaí bocht marbh...

english: Hmmm... How do you yet live warrior? Perhaps you have found your element here in the furnace? Curious...
irish: Hmmm... Cén chaoi a bhfuil tú fós ina gcónaí laoch? B'fhéidir go bhfuair tú do eilimint anseo sa foirnéis? Aisteach...

english: This is a place of transformation. Certain creatures find a new purpose here, becoming something more than they once were. Are you one of these creatures, I wonder?
irish: Is áit claochlaithe é seo. Faigheann créatúir áirithe cuspóir nua anseo, rud éigin níos mó ná mar a bhí siad uair amháin. An bhfuil tú ar cheann de na créatúir, N'fheadar?

english: Kraa! Those who first ventured here did not know about the underground thieves. If they had known, they would certainly have chosen better places to build their homesteads.
irish: Kraa! Ní raibh a fhios ag na daoine a fuair fiontair anseo ar dtús faoi na thieves faoi thalamh. Más eol dóibh, bheadh siad roghnaithe cinnte áiteanna níos fearr a thógáil a n-áit chónaithe.

english: Watch these lands for memorials in the honour of the warriors who came before you. They may bestow a boon upon you, should you prove yourself worthy in their eyes.
irish: Féach ar na tailte seo le haghaidh cuimhneacháin in onóir na laochra a tháinig os a gcomhair. Is féidir leo bhronnadh boon ar tú, ba chóir duit a chruthú duit féin fiú ina súile.

english: Long before the Allfather summoned you, others were tasked to guard this world. Even though many years have gone by since their passing, they still can't seem to find peace. Be kind, and do not disturb them.
irish: Fada roimh an Allfather thoghairm tú, bhí de chúram ar dhaoine eile a garda an saol seo. Cé go bhfuil blianta fada imithe ag ós rud é a rith, ní féidir leo cosúil go fóill síocháin a aimsiú. Bí cineálta, agus ná cuir isteach orthu.

english: Kraa! Strange folk dwell here, created from the very evil itself...
irish: Kraa! Strange dwell tíre anseo, a cruthaíodh as an olc féin...

english: Long ago, others attempted to sail to these lands. It appears they made it here, but that there was no way for them to make the return journey...
irish: Fada ó shin, rinne daoine eile iarracht a sheoladh chuig na tailte. Dealraíonn sé rinne siad é anseo, ach nach raibh aon bhealach dóibh a dhéanamh ar an turas ar ais...

english: Kraa! Well met, wanderer… I am Munin, brother to Hugin. I bring greetings from the Allfather. His eye sees through mine, I carry his words beneath my tongue. Keep his ways and I will come to you again…
irish: Kraa! Bhuel bhuail, wanderer... Tá mé Munin, deartháir go Hugin. Tugaim beannachtaí ón Uileathair. Feiceann a shúil trí mhianach, a dhéanamh mé a chuid focal faoi bhun mo theanga. Coinnigh a chuid bealaí agus beidh mé ag teacht chun tú arís...

english: Kraa! All eyes are on this one. Big eyes, little eyes, eyes from above and eyes from below. Even the trees have eyes…
irish: Kraa! Tá gach súile ar an gceann seo. Súile mór, súile beag, súile ó thuas agus súile ó thíos. Fiú go bhfuil na crainn súile...

english: Still you live, warrior? I had hoped for some little snack from your corpse, some morsel of carrion… Still, the Allfather will be pleased.
irish: Fós tú i do chónaí, laoch? Bhí súil agam le haghaidh roinnt sneaiceanna beag ó do chorp, roinnt morsel de cairéad... Fós, beidh an Allfather a bheith sásta.

english: Are you lost in the fog, warrior? I see things your eyes once knew, paths you trod and faces you loved. Poor warrior…
irish: An bhfuil tú caillte sa ceo, laoch? Feicim rudaí do shúile a fhios uair amháin, cosáin tú trod agus os comhair grá agat. laoch...

english: Kraa! Do not forget your quest, wanderer! Remember why the Allfather sent you here. The Forsaken Ones must be destroyed. Remember!
irish: Kraa! Ná déan dearmad ar do rompu, wanderer! Cuimhnigh cén fáth a chuir an Allfather tú anseo. Ní mór na cinn Tosaken a scriosadh. Cuimhnigh!

english: Ah, you have grown into a fine warrior! As a courtesy, I should tell you that when you die, we have agreed that Hugin will have your left eye as a treat and I will have your right. But we wish you well!
irish: Ah, tá tú tar éis fás isteach i laoch fíneáil! Mar chúirtéis, ba chóir dom a insint duit go nuair a fhaigheann tú bás, ní mór dúinn a d'aontaigh go mbeidh Hugin bhfuil do shúil chlé mar chóireáil agus beidh mé ag do cheart. Ach is mian linn tú go maith!

english: Kraa! Serve the Allfather well and he has given me leave to restore your memories. Do you remember the life you had before this one? It yet remembers you...
irish: Kraa! Freastal ar an Allfather maith agus thug sé dom a fhágáil a chur ar ais do cuimhní cinn. An cuimhin leat an saol a bhí agat roimh an gceann seo? Cuimhníonn sé go fóill tú...

english: I had not thought you would survive so long… But guard against pride, friend. Battlefields are banquets to me, I know how all great warriors end...
irish: Ní raibh shíl mé go mbeadh tú maireachtáil chomh fada... Ach garda i gcoinne bród, cara. Catha Tá féastaí dom, Tá a fhios agam conas gach laochra mór deireadh...

english: Kraa! Hear me now, I'll riddle you no longer. I am great Munin, the treasure-house of memory. I sit on the left shoulder of the Allfather and do his bidding in the ten worlds. I have seen many great warriors rise and fall but you are among the greatest. Know that Oden himself is watching you...
irish: Kraa! Caith dom anois, beidh mé riddle tú a thuilleadh. Tá mé München mór, an stór-teach de chuimhne. Suí mé ar an ghualainn chlé an Uileathair agus a dhéanamh ar a bidding sa deich saol. Feicthe mé go leor laochra mór ardú agus titim ach tá tú i measc an mó. A fhios go bhfuil Oden féin ag faire ort...

english: Kraa! The Allfather sends tidings! He waits on your word to send the great bridge. Kill the Forsaken Ones and clear the way!
irish: Kraa! Cuireann an Allfather tidings! Fanann sé ar do fhocal an droichead mór a sheoladh. Kill na cinn Forsaken agus soiléir ar an mbealach!

english: You were kicked from the online session due to the console going into Sleep mode, which suspends network activity.
irish: Bhí kicked tú as an seisiún ar líne mar gheall ar an consól ag dul isteach i mód Codladh, a fhionraí gníomhaíocht líonra.

english: It's unclear what this could be used for...
irish: Níl sé soiléir cad a d'fhéadfaí é seo a úsáid le haghaidh...
Nach bhfuil an mhír oiriúnach ann

english: Some clothes are just too nice to fold away. Why not put them on display instead?
irish: Tá roinnt éadaí ach ró-deas a huaire ar shiúl. Cén fáth nach iad a chur ar taispeáint ina ionad sin?

english: This intricate tool is needed for crafting more advanced designs.
irish: Tá an uirlis intricate ag teastáil le haghaidh crafting dearaí níos airde.

english: To build machinery and craft complicated designs, an artisan table is required.
irish: A thógáil innealra agus ceardaíochta dearaí casta, tá tábla artisan ag teastáil.

english: Rest easy on this finely crafted bed, with asksvin hides to insulate you from heat and cold alike.
irish: Rest éasca ar an leaba crafted mín, le seithí asksvin a insulate tú ó teas agus fuar araon.

english: You could watch this pattern for hours...
irish: D'fhéadfá féachaint ar an bpatrún le haghaidh uair an chloig...

english: Adds a nice detail to any room.
irish: Cuireann mion deas le haon seomra.

english: Are you looking out the window or at the window? Nobody needs to know.
irish: An bhfuil tú ag lorg amach an fhuinneog nó ag an fhuinneog? Ní mór aon duine a fhios.

english: The detailed decorations might make you stop and look instead of actually going through.
irish: D'fhéadfadh na maisiúcháin mionsonraithe a dhéanamh tú a stopadh agus breathnú in ionad dul i ndáiríre tríd.

english: Patterns work great on the floor as well.
irish: Patrúin ag obair go hiontach ar an urlár chomh maith.

english: These supports are always warm to the touch.
irish: Tá na tacaíochtaí seo i gcónaí te don teagmháil.

english: These stairs are sturdier than they might appear.
irish: Tá na staighre sturdier ná d'fhéadfadh siad le feiceáil.

english: Both sides of this wall have their own charm. The choice is yours!
irish: Tá a charm féin ag an dá thaobh den bhalla seo. Is é an rogha mise!

english: Gruesome or decorative? That is up to you.
irish: Gruesome nó maisiúil? Is é sin suas chun tú.

english: A black banner, like the depths of Hel.
irish: A banner dubh, cosúil leis an doimhneacht de Hel.

english: A blue banner, like the oceans around Midgard.
irish: A banner gorm, cosúil leis na haigéin ar fud Midgard.

english: A red striped banner, like a sail for a ship.
irish: A banner striped dearg, cosúil le seol do long.

english: A red banner, like the blood of Odin's foes.
irish: A banner dearg, cosúil leis an fhuil na foes Odin.

english: A green banner, like the lush forests of Alfheim.
irish: A banner glas, cosúil leis na foraoisí lush de Alfheim.

english: A red and blue striped banner, because sometimes you can't pick a colour.
irish: A banner dearg agus gorm striped, mar gheall ar uaireanta ní féidir leat a phiocadh dath.

english: A blue striped banner, like a sail for a ship.
irish: A banner striped gorm, cosúil le seol do long.

english: A yellow banner, like the golden fields of Vanaheim.
irish: A banner buí, cosúil leis na réimsí órga de Vanaheim.

english: A purple banner, like strange magics.
irish: A banner corcra, cosúil le draíocht aisteach.

english: An orange banner, like the fires of Muspelheim.
irish: An banner oráiste, cosúil leis an tinte de Muspelheim.

english: A white banner, like the snow in Niflheim.
irish: A banner bán, cosúil leis an sneachta i Niflheim.

english: Helps you stay up to date with the latest viking fashion.
irish: Cuidíonn tú fanacht suas chun dáta leis an bhealach inmharthana is déanaí.

english: Respectable vikings bathe as often as once per week!
irish: Boinn inmharthana chomh minic agus is uair sa tseachtain!

english: Draped in furs, this bed is sure to give you a good night's sleep.
irish: Draped i fionnaidh, tá an leaba cinnte a thabhairt duit oíche maith codlata.

english: When night falls, you'll want somewhere to sleep.
irish: Nuair a thiteann an oíche, beidh tú ag iarraidh áit éigin a chodladh.

english: The bees don't like this biome
irish: Níl an beacha cosúil leis an biome

english: When they're happy, the bees will produce tasty honey.
irish: Nuair a bhíonn siad sásta, beidh na beacha a tháirgeadh mil blasta.

english: The bees need more open space
irish: An gá beacha spás níos oscailte

english: If there is room in your heart, there is room for your butt.
irish: Má tá seomra i do chroí, tá seomra do Butt.

english: A rustic yet comfortable place to sit.
irish: Áit rustic fós compordach chun suí.

english: It's nothing fancy, but it's better than sitting on the ground.
irish: Tá sé rud ar bith mhaisiúil, ach tá sé níos fearr ná suí ar an talamh.

english: The birds don't like it here
irish: Ní maith leis na héin anseo

english: Healthy and happy birds might shed a feather or two.
irish: D'fhéadfadh éin Sláintiúil agus sásta a chaillfidh cleite nó dhó.

english: The birds need more open space
irish: Ní mór na héin spás níos oscailte

english: Certain metals, especially combined with other materials, need to be worked at a more advanced forge.
irish: Ní mór miotail áirithe, go háirithe in éineacht le hábhair eile, a bheith ag obair ag forge níos airde.

english: Let your new creations cool off before you touch them.
irish: Lig do bunú nua cool as sula dteagmháil leat iad.

english: It's convenient to have your project be held in place while you work.
irish: Tá sé áisiúil go mbeadh do thionscadal ar siúl agus tú ag obair.

english: For precise splitting of metal. Mind the sharp edges!
irish: Chun scoilteadh beacht de mhiotal. Mind an imill géar!

english: To work with gems, you need specific tools.
irish: A bheith ag obair le GEMS, is gá duit uirlisí ar leith.

english: When dealing with extreme temperatures, workplace safety is of the highest import.
irish: Agus é ag déileáil le teochtaí foircneacha, tá sábháilteacht san ionad oibre ar an iompórtáil is airde.

english: Sit with dignity on this bench, finely carved from black marble.
irish: Suigh le dínit ar an mbinse seo, snoite go mín ó marmair dubh.

english: Can be used for going both up and down. How convenient!
irish: Is féidir é a úsáid chun dul araon suas agus síos. Cé chomh áisiúil!

english: Dine like a dwarf at this table!
irish: Dine cosúil le dwarf ag an tábla seo!

english: A throne carved in authentic dvergr style, yet large enough for a human to sit comfortably upon.
irish: A ríchathaoir snoite i stíl dvergr barántúla, ach mór go leor do dhaoine chun suí go compordach ar.

english: A black marble piece inspired by dwarven architecture. The only limit is your own creativity.
irish: A píosa marmair dubh spreagtha ag ailtireacht dwarven. Is é an teorainn amháin do chruthaitheacht féin.

english: Sure to be the envy of all fulings!
irish: Cinnte a bheith ar an envy de gach fulings!

english: This bench has an elegant curve to it, to facilitate conversation.
irish: Tá cuar galánta ag an mbinse seo dó, chun comhrá a éascú.

english: No matter what, this stack of wood always feels warm.
irish: Is cuma cad, mothaíonn an Stack adhmaid i gcónaí te.

english: Some metals need higher temperatures to melt.
irish: Ní mór roinnt miotail teochtaí níos airde a leá.

english: This metal does have a more sinister air than others, doesn't it?
irish: Ní dhéanann an miotail seo aer níos sinister ná daoine eile, nach bhfuil sé?

english: This throne is sure to invoke respect in friends and foes alike.
irish: Tá an ríchathaoir cinnte a agairt meas i gcairde agus foes araon.

english: You never know when these might come in handy!
irish: Tá a fhios agat riamh nuair a d'fhéadfadh na teacht i handy!

english: For when a regular campfire just isn't impressive enough!
irish: Le haghaidh nuair nach bhfuil campfire rialta ach go hiontach go leor!

english: If your fire hangs from the ceiling, you can't accidentally stumble into it.
irish: Má hangs do dóiteáin as an uasteorainn, ní féidir leat stumble thaisme isteach é.

english: A classy way to light up the room.
irish: Bealach classy chun solais suas an seomra.

english: It's hard to tell whether this flame burns incredibly hot or incredibly cold.
irish: Tá sé deacair a rá an dóitear an lasair seo thar a bheith te nó thar a bheith fuar.

english: A small but incredibly cosy lightsource.
irish: A beag ach thar a bheith cosy lightsource.

english: Mark your discoveries on this map and share them with your friends.
irish: Marcáil do fionnachtana ar an léarscáil seo agus iad a roinnt le do chairde.

english: That doesn't fit in the catapult
Combine ingredients and cook yourself a tasty meal, important for all vikings!
irish: Comhábhair agus cócaireacht tú féin béile blasta, tábhachtach do gach vikings!

english: You need many ingredients for a varied and delicious diet.
irish: Ní mór duit go leor comhábhair le haghaidh aiste bia éagsúil agus delicious.

english: The finest dishes require the finest cuts.
irish: Éilíonn na miasa is fearr na gearrthacha is fearr.

english: Sometimes just a cauldron simply isn't enough.
irish: Uaireanta níl ach cauldron ach go leor.

english: Some ingredients need to be ground into a fine powder before they can be used for cooking.
irish: Ní mór roinnt comhábhair a bheith talamh i púdar fíneáil sular féidir iad a úsáid le haghaidh cócaireachta.

english: These always come in handy, particularly for baking.
irish: Na teacht i gcónaí i handy, go háirithe le haghaidh bácála.

english: Smoked food will keep longer and taste better!
irish: Beidh bia deataithe a choinneáil níos faide agus blas níos fearr!

english: Some flowers to brighten up your day!
irish: Roinnt bláthanna a brighten suas do lá!
Lean ar ais agus scíth a ligean.

english: The shape of this chair might be simple, but its decorations are not.
irish: D'fhéadfadh cruth an chathaoir seo a bheith simplí, ach níl a chuid maisiúcháin.

english: Useful for turning any kind of wood into coal.
irish: Úsáideacha chun aon chineál adhmaid a chasadh ina ghual.

english: A sturdier chest, with room for more storage.
irish: A cófra sturdier, le seomra le haghaidh níos mó stórála.

english: A barrel is good for storing lots of things, including food and drink.
irish: Tá bairille maith do stóráil go leor de na rudaí, lena n-áirítear bia agus deoch.

english: The sturdy black metal that holds this chest together lets you put almost anything inside.
irish: An miotail dubh sturdy go bhfuil an cófra le chéile ligeann tú a chur beagnach aon rud taobh istigh.

english: Stone and metal are sure to keep your belongings safe. The charred skulls help too.
irish: Tá cloch agus miotail cinnte a choinneáil do belongings sábháilte. An skulls charred cabhrú freisin.

english: Some things you would rather lock away and keep for yourself.
irish: Roinnt rudaí a bheadh tú glas in áit ar shiúl agus a choinneáil ar do shon féin.

english: What better way to display your wealth than a treasure chest spilling over with gold and jewels?
irish: Cad bealach níos fearr a thaispeáint do saibhreas ná cófra Treasure doirteadh thar le hór agus jewels?

english: A good place to store any items you don't need to carry with you.
irish: Áit mhaith a stóráil aon míreanna nach gá duit a dhéanamh leat.

english: Heavy curtains of red jute, excellent for draping.
irish: Cuirtíní trom de jute dearg, den scoth le haghaidh draping.

english: It never hurts to have a lot of fuel on hand.
irish: Riamh hurts sé go bhfuil a lán de breosla ar láimh.
Foirfe le haghaidh feoil amh grilling.

english: Sturdy, with room to cook meat from larger creatures.
irish: Sturdy, le seomra chun feoil a chócaráil ó créatúir níos mó.

english: Premium quality copper. Nothing to complain about!
irish: copar chaighdeán Préimh. Ní dhéanfaidh aon ní gearán faoi!

english: Make the soil ready for planting.
irish: Déan an ithir réidh le plandáil.

english: This chair is padded with furs, suitable for esteemed guests.
irish: Tá an cathaoirleach padded le fionnaidh, oiriúnach do aíonna esteemed.

english: An elegant design for decorating your home, and for keeping prying eyes away.
irish: Dearadh galánta le haghaidh maisiú do theach, agus le haghaidh a choinneáil súile prying ar shiúl.

english: A fancy and sturdy gate. To use by itself or as part of a pair.
irish: A geata mhaisiúil agus sturdy. Le húsáid aige féin nó mar chuid de péire.

english: Intricate designs run along this support structure.
irish: Riarann dearaí diana feadh an struchtúir tacaíochta seo.

english: The ravens are trusted companions of the Allfather, of course you would want one in your home as well.
irish: Is iad na ravens companions iontaofa an Allfather, ar ndóigh, ba mhaith leat ceann i do theach chomh maith.

english: This shallow roof is sure to keep the rain out, and look good doing it.
irish: Tá an díon éadomhain cinnte a choinneáil ar an báisteach amach, agus breathnú maith ag déanamh é.

english: This steeper roof is sure to keep the rain out, and look good doing it.
irish: Is é seo an díon níos géire cinnte a choinneáil ar an báisteach amach, agus breathnú maith ag déanamh air.

english: This very steep roof is sure to keep the rain out, and look good doing it.
irish: Tá an díon an-ghéar cinnte a choinneáil ar an báisteach amach, agus breathnú maith ag déanamh é.

english: Wolves are pack animals, but this one seems happy enough by itself.
irish: Tá Wolves ainmhithe pacáiste, ach is cosúil an ceann seo sásta go leor aige féin.

english: This wall won't do much to keep out the cold, but it's very pretty to look at.
irish: Ní bheidh an bhalla a dhéanamh i bhfad a choinneáil amach an fuar, ach tá sé an-go leor chun breathnú ar.

english: Both a bridge and a gate, how clever!
irish: An dá droichead agus geata, cé chomh cliste!

english: Convenient for crossing chasms, or for keeping enemies out.
irish: Áisiúil do chasms trasnú, nó do naimhde a choinneáil amach.

english: A finely wrought lantern, crafted by a true artisan. The wall mount is easy enough to figure out though!
irish: A laindéir fíneáil wrought, crafted ag ceardaí fíor. Is é an mount balla éasca go leor chun an figiúr amach cé!

english: You can build a pole easy enough, but the lantern can only have been made by a true master.
irish: Is féidir leat a thógáil cuaille éasca go leor, ach is féidir leis an laindéir a bheith déanta ach ag máistir fíor.

english: Dvergr design is all the rage these days.
irish: Tá dearadh Dvergr go léir an rage na laethanta.

english: The dvergr know how to keep unwanted visitors away.
irish: Tá a fhios ag an dvergr conas cuairteoirí nach dteastaíonn a choinneáil ar shiúl.

english: Reinforced with metal, this is sure to be a sturdy defence.
irish: Treisithe le miotail, tá sé seo cinnte a bheith ina chosaint sturdy.

english: This machine will turn soft tissue into the magical substance eitr. The process is quite volatile, however, so stand back!
irish: Cuirfidh an meaisín seo fíochán bog isteach san eitéar substainte draíochta. Tá an próiseas so-ghalaithe go leor, áfach, mar sin seasamh ar ais!

english: His rage and regret are at war with each other, and their struggle will fuel this fire until the very end.
irish: Tá a rage agus aiféala ag cogadh lena chéile, agus beidh a streachailt breosla an tine go dtí an deireadh an-.

english: Lends a gentle light to your festivities.
irish: Lends solas milis le do festivities.

english: Mead needs to sit and ferment for a while, for all its intended properties to emerge.
irish: Ní mór don mhoth suí agus coipeadh ar feadh tamaill, as a chuid maoine beartaithe go léir chun teacht chun cinn.

english: Useful for cooking, warmth, or just resting for a bit.
irish: Úsáideacha le haghaidh cócaireachta, teas, nó díreach resting le haghaidh beagán.

english: If you don't want to place a campfire directly onto the ground, this is a classy alternative.
irish: Más rud é nach bhfuil tú ag iarraidh a chur ar campfire díreach ar an talamh, tá sé seo ina rogha malartach classy.

english: The heat is practically radiating from this stack...
irish: Is é an teas radiating praiticiúil as an chairn...

english: An impressive way to welcome your friends, or to ward off your foes.
irish: Bealach iontach chun fáilte a chur roimh do chairde, nó chun bharda as do foes.

english: When you want to work with metal, you need a forge.
irish: Nuair is mian leat a bheith ag obair le miotail, is gá duit a chruthú.

english: Pressing down on these bellows generates more heat, which is very helpful for smithing.
irish: Ag brú síos ar na bellows Gineann teas níos mó, atá an-chabhrach do smithing.

english: For more detailed work, multiple kinds of anvils can come in handy.
irish: Le haghaidh obair níos mionsonraithe, is féidir le cineálacha éagsúla anvils teacht i handy.

english: A grinding wheel is necessary for sharpening any kind of sword.
irish: Tá roth meilt is gá chun géarú aon chineál claíomh.

english: A large anvil for working large items. Make sure it doesn't fall on your feet.
irish: A anvil mór le haghaidh obair míreanna móra. Bí cinnte nach dtagann sé ar do chosa.

english: Once a creation is done, this barrel of water will bring the metal down to a manageable temperature.
irish: Chomh luath agus a chruthú a dhéanamh, beidh an bairille uisce a thabhairt ar an miotail síos go dtí teocht inbhainistithe.

english: You need lots of different tools to work with. These conveniently come with a rack for storage.
irish: Ní mór duit go leor de na huirlisí éagsúla a bheith ag obair leis. Na teacht go caothúil le raca le haghaidh stórála.

english: This foundry can be used to harden casts into proper items.
irish: Is féidir an teilgean seo a úsáid chun teilgin a chruachadh i míreanna cuí.

english: A strange and chilling process happens within this kiln, to produce a most potent fuel...
irish: Tarlaíonn próiseas aisteach agus fuaraithe laistigh den kiln seo, chun breosla is potent a tháirgeadh...

english: These thin floor tiles are deceptively sturdy.
irish: Tá na tíleanna urláir tanaí deceptively sturdy.

english: Strong enough to withstand a land of fire.
irish: Láidir go leor chun talamh tine a sheasamh.

english: A roof design fit for the mightiest of halls.
irish: A oiriúnach dearadh díon don mightiest de hallaí.

english: Just take one step after the other.
irish: Just a ghlacadh céim amháin tar éis an ceann eile.

english: Good for getting to higher levels.
irish: Dea chun dul go dtí leibhéil níos airde.

english: Stone walls inspired by a long-gone civilisation.
irish: Ballaí cloiche spreagtha ag sibhialtacht fhada.

english: Grausten, carefully placed into a pile.
irish: Grausten, a chur go cúramach isteach i carn.

english: A sturdy iron torch to light up your surroundings.
irish: A torch iarainn sturdy chun solais suas do thimpeallacht.

english: A sturdy iron torch, emitting an eerie blue light.
irish: A torch iarainn sturdy, astú solas gorm eerie.

english: Bind the wisp to a fixed spot, to ensure the place is always free of mist.
irish: Ceangail an wisp ar an láthair seasta, chun a chinntiú go bhfuil an áit i gcónaí saor ó olc.

english: A sturdy iron torch, burning with a green flame.
irish: A torch iarainn sturdy, dhó le lasair glas.

english: A torch to stick in the ground, for when you need your hands free.
irish: A torch a bata sa talamh, le haghaidh nuair is gá duit do lámha saor in aisce.

irish: Emits séala draíochta ar an timpeallacht in aice láimhe a chuireann cosc ar imreoirí eile ó thógáil foirgnimh nó doirse a oscailt.

irish: Déanann jute gorm aon fhoirgneamh cuma oifigiúil agus tábhachtach.

This dwarven design is excellent for keeping unwanted guests out.
irish: Tá an dearadh dwarven den scoth le haghaidh aíonna nach dteastaíonn a choinneáil amach.

english: Aimed in just one direction, the light grows more potent. Convenient for sneak thieves, or those who wish to leave a trail.
irish: Aimed i díreach treo amháin, fásann an solas níos potent. Áisiúil do thieves sneak, nó iad siúd ar mian leo a fhágáil rian.

english: Thor bestows a gift upon you!
If you have iron, you have everything.
irish: Má tá tú iarainn, tá gach rud agat.

english: Finely crafted iron bars, sure to be rattle-proof!
irish: barraí iarainn crafted Finely, cinnte a bheith ramhar-cruthúnas!
Ní féidir leat an mhír seo a cheangal

english: Place items on horizontal surfaces with this item stand.
irish: Cuir míreanna ar dhromchlaí cothrománacha leis an seastán mír seo.

irish: Míreanna Mount ar dhromchlaí ingearach leis an seastán mír.

english: The face carved into this vegetable...is it spooky or friendly?
irish: An aghaidh snoite isteach sa glasraí...is spooky nó cairdiúil é?

english: This coarse fabric is excellent for keeping the cold at bay.
irish: Tá an creatlach garbh seo den scoth chun an fuar a choinneáil ag bá.

english: No matter how misty the air is, this carpet doesn't appear to get damp.
irish: Is cuma cé chomh olc go bhfuil an t-aer, nach bhfuil an cairpéad dealraitheach a fháil taise.

english: If the terrain is too lumpy, you can just flatten it.
irish: Má tá an tír-raon ró-chnapánach, is féidir leat é a leacú.

english: Mysterious galdr forces gather upon this altar. It's up to you to harness them...
irish: fórsaí réaltra mistéireach bhailiú ar an altóir. Tá sé suas chun tú chun leas a bhaint astu...

english: These candles emit a strange light, urging more potent magic to coalesce around them.
irish: Na coinnle astaíonn solas aisteach, lorg draíochta níos potent a coalesce timpeall orthu.

english: An offering to the mysterious powers scattered across the realms. Perhaps they will lend themselves to you.
irish: tairiscint do na cumhachtaí mistéireach scaipthe ar fud na realms. B'fhéidir go mbeidh siad ar iasacht iad féin a thabhairt duit.

irish: Na Norns weave na snáitheanna de cinniúint le chéile i téipeanna draíochta. Cad a fhífidh tú?

english: Runes are a well-known tool for channeling magic, if one knows how to read them.

english: This copper pot holds the perfect temperature for mixing mead.

english: You can't help but to feel like there's something romantic about this...
irish: Ní féidir leat cabhrú ach a bhraitheann cosúil go bhfuil rud éigin rómánsúil mar gheall ar seo...
Amharc ar ár liosta iomlán de shuíomhanna

english: Though rustic and sturdy, this throne is well suited even for the most noble of royalty.

english: A pile as dark as the night itself.

I gcás gach do riachtanais bácála.

irish: Marcáil amach an bealach is fearr ar aghaidh.

Ní féidir fás sa timpeallacht seo

irish: Ceangail le tairseach eile le clib comhionann nó gan aon.

irish: Tá píosa ráiteas mór de phota! D'fhéadfá a d'oirfeadh beagnach inmharthana ar fad ann.

irish: Tá píosa ceirmeach, domhain go leor a d'oirfeadh rud nó dhá taobh istigh.

irish: Tá píosa beag de cré-earraí, le seomra le haghaidh rud éigin taobh istigh.

irish: Ní féidir gach rud a dhoirteadh go díreach isteach sa chauldron, mar sin ní mór duit dromchla maith a bheith ag obair ar!

english: Fill holes and create elevated platforms.
irish: Poill líonadh agus ardáin ardaithe a chruthú.

english: Restore the ground to its original vegetation.
irish: Athchóirigh an talamh ar a fásra bunaidh.

english: Adds a rustic touch to any garden.
irish: Cuireann sé teagmháil rustic le haon ghairdín.

irish: Leis an gcaoi a n-iarrann lumpy i bhfolach, tá sé deacair rud ar bith a dhéanamh úsáideach ó phíosa amháin. Tá roinnt tionól ag teastáil.
