irish: Is uigeacht aisteach é, ach píosa maisiú an-suimiúil.
Tá sé thar a bheith fluffy!

irish: Tá an cairpéad sewn go néata le chéile, chun dromchla mór, bog a chinntiú.

english: This rug is so soft, soft like innocence.

irish: Te agus Cosy, go háirithe suas sna sléibhte.
Ní dhéanfaidh aon ní a bhaint

irish: Grán láidir is féidir a bheith ina phlúr.

irish: Síolta cairéad plandaí ag fás cairéid

irish: Bláthanna roimh le snáithíní is féidir a spun isteach sa snáithe.

irish: Plandaí cairéad chun níos mó síolta a fháil

irish: Plandaí oinniún chun níos mó síolta a fháil.

english: Plant a turnip to get more seeds

irish: A glasraí hearty a úsáidtear le haghaidh cócaireachta.

Riachtanais rud éigin a cling go.

irish: Soláthraíonn adhmad forluí de na ballaí seo cosaint den scoth i gcoinne na n-eilimintí.

irish: Cén fáth bata torch sa talamh nuair is féidir leat é a chrochadh ar do bhalla?

irish: Má thagann duine éigin ró-dlúth, beidh siad poked.

irish: Cruthaigh sciath a chosaint i gcoinne aimsir agus diúracáin ag teacht isteach. Breosla ag cnámha d'aon chineál.

irish: Is disorder namhaid is measa marthanóir. Cosain tú féin ina choinne trí comharthaí a chur suas.

english: A tidy way of displaying your wealth.
irish: Bealach slachtmhar a thaispeáint do saibhreas.

irish: A cruthúnas áirithe de do prowess i chomhrac.

irish: Breosla agus ore dul i, ingots miotail álainn teacht amach.

irish: Cuireann teagmháil chosy le tírdhreach wintry.

irish: Déanann an meaisín uathoibrithe snáithíní sníomh isteach snáithe próiseas thar cuimse tapaidh.

irish: Cuireann na tacaíochtaí seo teagmháil tasteful agus maisiúil.

irish: Tá ballaí adhmaid trom maith chun an fuar a choinneáil amach.

english: These thick chunks of wood are sure to support your constructions.
irish: Tá na smutáin tiubh adhmaid cinnte chun tacú le do tógálacha.

english: Not quite as glorious as the gates of Valhalla, but awfully close!
irish: Ní leor mar glorious mar na geataí Valhalla, ach awfully gar!

english: If you want to build with stone, you'll need a stonecutter to work the material.
irish: Más mian leat a thógáil le cloch, beidh ort stonecutter chun an t-ábhar a oibriú.

english: Stones carefully pieced together into a sturdy fence.
irish: Clocha le chéile go cúramach i fál sturdy.

english: Best to put a rug on it, or it might get cold!
irish: Is fearr rug a chur air, nó d'fhéadfadh sé fuar a fháil!

english: It's a big pile of stone.
irish: Tá sé ina carn mór de chloch.

irish: Úsáideacha chun dul timpeall i fortress mór.

irish: A bloc garbh hewn de chloch.

irish: Tá an tábla seo foirfe le haghaidh féasta mór, le seomra le haghaidh go leor miasa éagsúla!

irish: Ag bord cruinn, níl aon suíochán níos tábhachtaí ná aon cheann eile.

irish: Is é an scéal snoite isteach sa tábla seo den scoth a léamh le linn féastaí fada.

irish: Tá tábla le haghaidh cruinnithe níos pearsanta.

irish: B'fhéidir gurb é seo an méid a Breathnaíonn ríchathaoir Odin i Valhalla cosúil le... Ceachtar slí, tá sé compordach!

english: You can make a lot of bronze with this...
irish: Is féidir leat a lán cré-umha a dhéanamh leis seo...

english: Step close at your own risk!
irish: Céim gar ar do riosca féin!

irish: Beidh an gaiste clamp síos ar cibé céimeanna ar sé. Cúramach!

english: A small fortune, gleaming and glittering.
irish: A fortune beag, gleaming agus glittering.

english: It's important to keep count of your coins.
irish: Tá sé tábhachtach a choinneáil ar chomhaireamh de do boinn.

irish: Struchtúr cosanta go diúracáin shoots ag aon rud a fhaigheann ar a bhealach.

irish: Casann gráin isteach i plúr. Oibríonn sé is fearr ar laethanta na gaoithe!

english: Attracts wisps. They mostly come at night... mostly.
irish: Caitheamh aimsire. Tagann siad den chuid is mó san oíche... den chuid is mó.

irish: An wisps ag iarraidh spás níos oscailte

irish: A carn mór de logs, úr ó na foraoise.

irish: Doras simplí le haghaidh oscailt agus dúnadh.

irish: Déan do bhaile legendary ag maisiú sé le Dragon.

irish: Fál maith, le haghaidh beostoic agus barra araon!

irish: Tá geata i bhfad níos praiticiúla ná léim thar an fál gach uair.

irish: Tá an carn adhmaid ag fanacht le iompú isteach i troscán.

irish: Tá beagán soladach de flooring adhmaid.

irish: Tá sé mar má thit sneachta úr díreach air...

irish: A geata adhmaid simplí. Le húsáid aige féin nó mar chuid de péire.

english: The strongest support you've ever built.
irish: An tacaíocht is láidre atá tógtha agat riamh.

english: Support your constructions in this rustic style.
irish: Tacaíocht do tógálacha sa stíl rustic.

irish: Tá díon simplí a choinneáil ar an bháisteach amach, tógtha ag uillinn éadomhain.

english: A simple roof to keep the rain out, with a steeper angle.
irish: Tá díon simplí a choinneáil ar an bháisteach amach, le uillinn níos géire.

english: A simple roof to keep the rain out, built at a very steep angle.
irish: Tá díon simplí a choinneáil ar an bháisteach amach, tógtha ag uillinn an-ghéar.

english: Put all that hard work on display!
irish: Cuir go léir go obair chrua ar taispeáint!

english: Good for getting off the ground.
irish: Dea chun dul as an talamh.
áisiúil le haghaidh dreapadóireachta níos airde.

english: Walls are an important part of any house!
irish: Tá ballaí mar chuid thábhachtach d'aon teach!

english: Open or closed, keep it the way you prefer or switch things up whenever you feel like it!
irish: Oscailte nó dúnta, é a choinneáil ar an mbealach is fearr leat nó rudaí a athrú suas aon uair a bhraitheann tú mhaith é!

irish: Tá gá le binse oibre le haghaidh aon bhaile. Ní mór duit é a thógáil struchtúir adhmaid agus uirlisí nua ceardaíochta.

irish: Is axe uirlis an-versatile le haghaidh crafting.

irish: Ní mór cóireáil chuí a bheith ag leathar agus ag seithí sula bhféadfar iad a úsáid.

irish: brainsí fíneáil, ag dul le fuinneamh mistéireach.

irish: Tá sé deacair smaoineamh ar rud ar bith níos féile ná fleasc!

irish: Tá bronntanas beag do dhuine is mian leat.

irish: Tá bronntanas mór do dhuine meas tú a lán.

irish: Tá an crann lámhaigh tugtha soilse maisiúil Fhéile.

Úsáid earra ar an barra te

english: How quickly an element is selected when hovering over it. Set to "Off" to disable hover selection.
irish: Cé chomh tapa a roghnaítear eilimint nuair a bhíonn sé ag dul thar. Socraigh go "Off" a roghnú hover disable.

english: Game restart is required when changing language.
irish: Caithfear an cluiche a atosú nuair a athraíonn tú teanga.

english: When scrolling through a radial menu with multiple pages, the top-most element will always be a back button.
irish: Nuair a scrollú trí roghchlár rada le leathanaigh iolracha, beidh an ghné is mó i gcónaí ar ais cnaipe.

english: PlayFab timed out! Make sure you are connected to the internet.
irish: PlayFab imithe thar am! Cinntigh go bhfuil nasc idirlín agat.

english: Balanced mode compromises between performance and quality.
irish: Comhréitigh mód chothromaithe idir feidhmíocht agus cáilíocht.

english: *Please set your device to support 120Hz graphic output.
irish: *Socraigh do ghléas le tacaíocht 120Hz aschuir ghrafaicí.

english: Performance mode favors smooth gameplay with higher frame rate.
irish: Is fearr modh feidhmíochta gameplay réidh le ráta fráma níos airde.

english: Quality mode favors the game's good looks over frame rate.
irish: Mod cáilíochta favors Breathnaíonn an cluiche maith os cionn ráta fráma.

english: Very poor quality, but can be played on a weak system.
irish: Caighdeán an-lag, ach is féidir a imirt ar chóras lag.

english: Enables build piece selection with the right mouse button.
irish: Cumasaíonn sé roghnú píosa tógála le cnaipe dheis na luiche.

english: Control the size and location of the Radial Menu
irish: Rialaigh méid agus suíomh an roghchláir radaigh

english: When the game is not in focus, e.g. while minimized, it will use less resources.
irish: Nuair nach bhfuil an cluiche i bhfócas, e.g. nuair a íoslaghdaítear é, úsáidfidh sé níos lú acmhainní.

english: Reduces the strength of lightning effects.
Resolution of the game elements other than UIs. Can be used either or both to increase performance or create a more retro look.
irish: Rún na heilimintí cluiche seachas UIs. Is féidir é a úsáid ceachtar nó an dá feidhmíocht a mhéadú nó cuma níos retro a chruthú.
An oibríonn sé seo i gceart?

english: Only play with players on PlayStation™Network. Disables all interaction with Cross-platform users. Can only be toggled in the main menu.
irish: Ach imirt le himreoirí ar Playstation TMNetwork. Díchumasaigh gach idirghníomhaíocht le húsáideoirí Cross-platform. Ní féidir é a scoránaigh ach sa phríomh-roghchlár.

english: Activates more tooltips informing you about controls in the menus.
irish: Gníomhachtaíonn sé tuilleadh leideanna faoi rialuithe sna roghchláir.

english: Increasing the draw distance may severly degrade performance!
irish: Má mhéadaíonn tú an fad tarraingthe, laghdófar feidhmíocht go mór!

english: Determines instensity of the spiral effect. When scrolling through a radial menu with multiple pages, elements next to the selected one will be scaled and moved to create a spiral-staircase-like effect. If turned off, the elements will only fade in and out. Please note that this setting requires Animate Radial to be enabled.
irish: Socraigh déine an éifeacht bíseach. Nuair a scrollú trí roghchlár rada le leathanaigh éagsúla, beidh eilimintí in aice leis an gceann roghnaithe a scála agus a bhogadh chun éifeacht bíseach-stairseach-mhaith a chruthú. Má iompú amach, ní bheidh na heilimintí céimnithe ach amháin i agus amach. Tabhair faoi deara go n-éilíonn an suíomh seo Animate Radial a chur ar chumas.

english: If off, attacks will instead be made in the direction the camera is facing.
irish: Má tá sé as, déanfar ionsaithe sa treo a bhíonn an ceamara ag féachaint.

english: Oden will send his ravens to advise you in your adventures.
irish: Seolfaidh Óðinn a phréacháin chun tú a chomhairleú i do heachtraí.

english: Enables the use of a radial menu for inventory navigation.
irish: Cumasaíonn sé úsáid roghchláir radaigh don fhardal.

english: His blade was dipped in poison, I stood no chance...
irish: Bhí tumtha a lann i nimh, sheas mé aon seans...

english: Pain, sharp and excruciating. And then nothing.
irish: Péine, géar agus excruciating. Agus ansin rud ar bith.

english: Fire doesn't warm me any longer, nor does it offer any true light.
irish: Ní Dóiteáin te dom a thuilleadh, ná ní chuireann sé ar fáil aon solas fíor.

english: I don't recall what it was like to not be numb and cold.
irish: Ní féidir liom a thabhairt chun cuimhne cad a bhí sé cosúil le nach numb agus fuar.

english: Her knife found my heart just as I slit her throat. We died next to each other.
irish: Fuair a scian mo chroí díreach mar scoilt mé a scornach. Fuaireamar bás in aice lena chéile.

english: This is not Valhalla, nor is it Hel. No, this is something far worse.
irish: Níl an Tweet seo ar fáil. Níl, tá sé seo rud éigin i bhfad níos measa.

english: A dead man out of mind...
Father... I failed you. I'm sorry...
irish: Athair... theip orm tú. Tá brón orm...

english: Forgive me, sister, for I could not follow in your footsteps.
irish: logh dom, deirfiúr, do ní raibh mé in ann a leanúint i do footsteps.

english: I went with him until the end...
irish: Chuaigh mé leis go dtí an deireadh...

english: Is someone there? I... I could have sworn I saw somebody.
irish: An bhfuil duine éigin ann? D'fhéadfadh mé a bheith faoi mhionn chonaic mé duine éigin.

english: Just one more step. Just one more.
irish: Just céim amháin níos mó. Díreach amháin níos mó.

english: These were the last of the lands we knew...
irish: Ba iad seo an ceann deireanach de na tailte a fhios againn...

english: This waste I know not, nor this dark night...
irish: An dramhaíl Níl a fhios agam, ná an oíche dorcha...

english: I thought I saw someone walking beside me, but it was but a shadow.
irish: Shíl mé chonaic mé duine éigin ag siúl in aice liom, ach bhí sé ach scáth.

english: I no longer feel the sun on my face, nor the ground beneath my feet.
irish: Braitheann mé a thuilleadh ar an ghrian ar mo aghaidh, ná an talamh faoi bhun mo chosa.

english: I've... I've become so very numb.
irish: Tá mé... Tá mé a bheith chomh an- numb.

english: My purpose has been served, yet no reward was given. Now I walk here, without a use...
irish: Tá mo chuspóir a sheirbheáil, ach tugadh aon luaíocht. Anois siúl mé anseo, gan úsáid...

english: There is so much blood... How much can a person bleed before they are gone?
irish: Tá an oiread sin fola... Cé mhéad is féidir le duine bleed sula bhfuil siad imithe?

english: The sorrow of my defeat, everlasting...
irish: An brón ar mo defeat, everlasting...

english: I still feel the sharp antlers piercing my chest. When will I be free of this pain?
irish: Braitheann mé fós ar an antlers géar piercing mo cófra. Cathain a bheidh mé saor ón bpian seo?

english: I thought she was reaching out to me, but then lightning spilled from her fingertips.
irish: Shíl mé go raibh sí a bhaint amach dom, ach ansin doirte tintreach as a fingertips.

english: Such strange creatures there are to be found here. I had hoped they were friendly.
irish: Tá créatúir aisteach den sórt sin le fáil anseo. Bhí súil agam go raibh siad cairdiúil.

english: Can you hear their voices? They still remain...
irish: An féidir leat a chloisteáil a gcuid guthanna? Tá siad fós...

english: I came so far, only for it to be over in the blink of an eye.
irish: Tháinig mé go dtí seo, ach amháin chun é a bheith os a chionn i blink na súl.

english: Such beautiful shifting, undulating colours... Why can't I reach them?
irish: Aistriú álainn den sórt sin, dathanna míchuí... Cén fáth nach féidir liom iad a bhaint amach?

english: Was this my destiny? To fall before I ever reached my goal?
irish: An raibh sé seo mo cinniúint? Chun titim sula shroich mé riamh mo sprioc?

english: So much blood spilled, and for what?
irish: An oiread sin fola doirte, agus cad?

english: The sizzling waters are eating through your hull, turn back!
irish: Na huiscí sizzling ag ithe trí do chabhail, cas ar ais!

english: A small and sleek ship, ready to set sail.
irish: A long beag agus sleek, réidh a leagtar seol.

english: A massive ship, sturdy enough to sail on even the most dangerous seas.
irish: A long ollmhór, sturdy go leor chun dul ar fiú na farraigí is contúirtí.

english: A mighty viking ship for sailing to distant shores.
irish: A long inmharthana mighty do seoltóireacht go dtí cladaigh i bhfad i gcéin.

english: It may not look like much, but a raft will get you farther than swimming!
irish: Ní fhéadfadh sé cuma mhaith i bhfad, ach beidh rafta a fháil tú níos faide ná snámh!

english: Damage absorbed when blocking with a weapon or shield.
irish: Damáiste absorbed nuair a blocáil le arm nó sciath.

english: Damage, eitr and health drain when using blood magic.
irish: Damáiste, eitinn agus draein sláinte nuair a úsáid draíocht fola.

english: Cooking speed, serving tray wear and chance for bonus yields.
irish: Luas cócaireachta, ag freastal ar chaitheamh tráidire agus seans do thorthaí bónas.

english: Crafting speed, hammer wear and building stamina use.
irish: Luas Ceardaíochta, caitheamh casúr agus a thógáil stamina úsáid.

english: Damage and eitr usage when using elemental magic.
irish: Damáiste agus úsáid eite nuair a úsáid draíocht eiliminteach.

english: Stamina use, cultivator wear, harvest radius and chance for bonus yields.
irish: Úsáid Stamina, caitheamh saothruitheoir, gathacha fómhar agus seans do thorthaí bónas.

english: Stamina drain and pull speed when fishing.
irish: Stamina draein agus luas tarraingt nuair a iascaireacht.

english: Speed and stamina drain when running.
irish: Luas agus stamina draein nuair a rith.

english: Stamina drain and stealthiness when sneaking.
irish: Stamina draein agus stealthiness nuair sneaking.
Damáiste nuair a bheidh sé gan airm.
Damáiste Axe nuair a bualadh crainn.
Uasmhéid laethanta as a chéile marthanach

english: Death by falling off the edge of the world
irish: Bás trí thitim thar imeall an domhain

english: Distance sailed, while manning the helm
Explore the far east, without using a map
irish: Taiscéal an oirthear i bhfad gan léarscáil

english: Explore the far north, without using a map
irish: Taiscéal an tuaisceart i bhfad gan léarscáil

english: Explore the far south, without using a map
irish: Taiscéal an deisceart i bhfad gan léarscáil

english: Explore the far west, without using a map
irish: Taiscéal an iarthar i bhfad gan léarscáil
Pointe domhanda is airde de thógáil

english:
The following actions may result in temporary or permanent bans from playing online:
• Harassment, hate speech, threats, or discrimination.
• Sharing inappropriate or offensive content via chat, in-game building or other means.
irish:
D'fhéadfadh go mbeadh toirmeasc sealadach nó buan ar na gníomhaíochtaí seo a leanas ar líne a imirt:
• Harassment, fuathchaint, bagairtí, nó idirdhealú.

english: This game has an autosave feature. Please don't turn off the game or console when you see the autosave icon.
irish: Tá an cluiche gné autosave. Ná cas amach an cluiche nó consól nuair a fheiceann tú an deilbhín autosave.

english: You can filter map pins by type with the Right Button (ZR Button with Joy-Con 2 mouse controls)
irish: Is féidir leat a scagadh bioráin léarscáil de réir cineáil leis an Button Ceart (ZR Button le Joy-Con 2 rialuithe luch)

english: You have run out of system memory, so the character could not be created.
irish: Tá tú ag rith amach as cuimhne an chórais, mar sin ní fhéadfaí an carachtar a chruthú.

english: You have run out of system memory, so the world could not be created.
irish: Tá tú ag rith amach as cuimhne an chórais, mar sin ní fhéadfaí an domhan a chruthú.

english: This operation failed because system memory is full. Please remove unused save data and try again.
irish: Theip ar an oibríocht seo toisc go bhfuil cuimhne an chórais iomlán. Bain úsáid as sonraí a shábháil agus déan iarracht arís.

english: You were kicked from the online session due to the Nintendo Switch 2 console going into sleep mode, which suspends network activity.
irish: Cuireadh kicked tú as an seisiún ar líne mar gheall ar an Nintendo Switch 2 consól ag dul i mód codlata, a fhionraí gníomhaíocht líonra.

english: Motion controls are OFF! Check settings.
irish: Tá rialuithe tairiscint OFF! Seiceáil socruithe.

english: Quickly tapping the stick towards the same element twice will interact with it.
irish: Go tapa tapping an bata i dtreo an eilimint chéanna faoi dhó idirghníomhú leis.

english: Quickly moving the stick towards an element will interact with it.
irish: Beidh go tapa ag bogadh an bata i dtreo eilimint idirghníomhú leis.

english: When scrolling through a radial menu with multiple pages, the top-most element will always be a back button.
irish: Nuair a scrollú trí roghchlár rada le leathanaigh iolracha, beidh an ghné is mó i gcónaí ar ais cnaipe.

english: The gate is sealed. The key is scattered and hidden, deep in the mines, so it might never again be unsealed. The gate is sealed.
irish: Tá an geata séalaithe. Tá an eochair scaipthe agus i bhfolach, domhain sna mianaigh, mar sin d'fhéadfadh sé a bheith riamh arís unsealed. Tá an geata séalaithe.
Le do thoil íoslódáil paiste a imirt

english: This is a force to be reckoned with. Fuel it up and bring it to your enemies' stronghold for a greater chance of success.
irish: Is fórsa atá le háireamh leis. Breosla sé suas agus é a thabhairt chuig do naimhde' láidir le haghaidh seans níos mó de rath.

english: Convenient when you need to move a lot of resources around.
irish: Áisiúil nuair is gá duit a bhogadh go leor acmhainní timpeall.

english: If you can't go through it, perhaps you can go over it...
irish: Más rud é nach féidir leat dul tríd, b'fhéidir gur féidir leat dul os a chionn...

english:
You have found the summoning place of one of the Forsaken. Make the correct offering at their altar and they will come.

Be wary though, the Forsaken are not easy prey, so craft a wicked weapon, don your finest armour, and eat a hearty meal before engaging them in combat.
irish:
Fuair tú an áit thoghairme ar cheann de na Forsaken. Déan an tairiscint ceart ag a n-altóir agus beidh siad ag teacht.

Bí fainiciúil cé, nach bhfuil an Forsaken chreiche éasca, mar sin ceardaíochta arm ghránna, ná do armúr is fearr, agus a ithe béile hearty roimh dul i ngleic leo.

english:
Now you'll be able to craft ceramic tiles, which have excellent heat insulation.
You'll need them if you're to travel southwards!
irish:
Anois beidh tú in ann a ceardaíochta tíleanna ceirmeacha, a bhfuil insliú teasa den scoth.
Beidh ort iad má tá tú chun taisteal ó dheas!

english:
It seems you have ventured to the boiling waters of the south. As you surely noted, this can be a deadly pursuit.
To traverse these waters you will need to build something sturdier if you dont want to sleep with the fishes.
irish:
Dealraíonn sé go bhfuil tú ag fiontair le huiscí fiuchphointe an deisceart. Mar a thug tú faoi deara surely, is féidir é seo a bheith ina tóir deadly.
Chun na huiscí beidh ort rud éigin sturdier a thógáil más rud é nach mian leat codladh leis na fishes.

english:
You have discovered the Ashlands, the very hottest parts of the tenth world.
Here, water boils without a cauldron, and anything flammable can be set alight with just a spark. Be careful!
irish:
Tá tú amach an Ashlands, na codanna an- teo ar fud an domhain deichiú.
Anseo, boils uisce gan cauldron, agus is féidir aon rud inlasta a shocrú le spréach amháin. Bí cúramach!

english: Jump in, the water's nice and warm!
irish: Léim i, an t-uisce deas agus te!

english: The enemy fortresses are built from sturdy stuff. You'll need machines like this one if you're to break through their walls.
irish: An fortresses namhaid tógtha ó stuif sturdy. Beidh ort meaisíní cosúil leis an gceann seo má tá tú a bhriseadh trína ballaí.

english:
Sleep the night away in your bed and awaken feeling refreshed and full of energy.

Another improvement to your home would be some chests where you can store items. <color=yellow>It is good practice to always have some spare equipment</color>, if something unfortunate should happen to you while exploring...
irish:
Codladh an oíche ar shiúl i do leaba agus mhúscailt mothú athnuachan agus iomlán fuinnimh.

Bheadh feabhas eile ar do theach a bheith roinnt cófraí nuair is féidir leat míreanna a stóráil. dath = buí Tá sé dea-chleachtas a bheith i gcónaí ar roinnt trealamh spártha / dath ., más rud é ba chóir rud éigin trua a tharlóidh duit agus iniúchadh...
A il an am atá caite

english: You have wandered into the Black Forest. This place can be very dangerous for those unprepared for it. Prove your worth by slaying Eikthyr.
irish: Tá tú wandered isteach sa Foraoise Dubh. Is féidir an áit seo a bheith an-chontúirteach dóibh siúd gan ullmhú dó. Cruthaigh do fiú ag slaying Eikthyr.

english: Turn back! This is a dangerous place
irish: Cas ar ais! Níl an Tweet seo ar fáil

english: Return to the Sacrificial Stones with your Forsaken trophy and offer it as a sacrifice to make the Gods smile upon you.
irish: Fill ar ais chuig na Clocha Íobairt le do trófaí Forsaken agus é a thairiscint mar íobairt a dhéanamh ar an aoibh gháire Dé ar tú.

english:
When the temperature drops at night, or if you are wet, you will suffer from being cold. This reduces your stamina regeneration.

Seeking shelter by an open flame is your best option when this happens.
irish:
Nuair a thiteann an teocht san oíche, nó má tá tú fliuch, beidh tú ag fulaingt ó bheith fuar. Laghdaíonn sé seo do athghiniúint stamina.

Is é an foscadh ag lasair oscailte do rogha is fearr nuair a tharlaíonn sé seo.

english:
Delves and dungeons can be found across the tenth world. They are monuments of the past, and most often filled with the riches of civilizations long lost.

Remember to bring a light source!
irish:
Is féidir Delves agus dungeons a fháil ar fud an domhain deichiú. Tá siad séadchomharthaí ar an am atá caite, agus is minic a líonadh leis an riches na sibhialtachtaí caillte fada.

Cuimhnigh a thabhairt foinse solais!

english:
Each time you are struck down, you will <color=yellow">forget a small part of your abilities and drop your belongings</color> at the site of the accident.

If you wish you were home by now I'd recommend <color=yellow">building a bed</color>, wherever home may be.
irish:
Gach uair a bhuail tú síos, beidh tú lí=buí" a bhrú amach cuid bheag de do chumas agus titim do belongings / dath lí ar an suíomh na timpiste.

Más mian leat go raibh tú sa bhaile ag anois ba mhaith liom a mholadh líofa = buí "thógáil leaba / lí, cibé áit a d'fhéadfadh a bheith sa bhaile.

english: Kra-kraaa! Stubborn fools! The Dvergr will tolerate strangers and vagrants but they are quick to anger should you upset them... Which I am sure you will manage to do sooner or later.
irish: Kra-Kraaaa! amadáin Grabheirthe! Beidh an Dvergr fhulaingt strainséirí agus vagrants ach tá siad tapa a fearg ba chóir duit trína chéile iad... Cad tá mé cinnte go mbeidh tú a bhainistiú a dhéanamh luath nó mall.

english:
As I am sure my lesser brother tells you, the halls beyond are very impressive...

Just try not to get lost in the winding tunnels and secret passageways will you?
irish:
Mar tá mé cinnte Insíonn mo dheartháir níos lú tú, tá na hallaí thar an-suntasach...

Just iarracht a dhéanamh gan a fháil caillte sna tolláin foirceannadh agus pasáistí rúnda a bheidh tú?

english:
It seems you have had a sip from an Yggdrasil branch, and I bet you found it to your liking.
Those fun colored lights you may see spinning around you might not all be in your head anymore.
Just don't make it a habit. There may be some long term effects that are anything but magical.
irish:
Dealraíonn sé go bhfuil tú go raibh sip ó bhrainse Yggdrasil, agus geall mé fuair tú é le do liking.
Na soilse daite spraoi is féidir leat a fheiceáil sníomh timpeall ní fhéadfadh tú a bheith go léir i do cheann níos mó.
Ní hamháin go ndéanann sé nós. D'fhéadfadh roinnt éifeachtaí fadtéarmacha go bhfuil aon rud ach draíochta.

english:
The mists permeate all that live and grow in these lands, and now it is a part of you as well.

With eitr you will be able to cast all sorts of powerful spells. Try to find more eitr-infused ingredients to increase your ability.
irish:
Na mists permeate go léir go bhfuil cónaí agus ag fás sna tailte, agus anois tá sé mar chuid de tú chomh maith.

Le eitéar beidh tú in ann a chaitheamh gach cineál na geasa cumhachtach. Bain triail as a fháil níos eitr-infused comhábhair a mhéadú do chumas.

english:
Well done, warrior!
At long last, you have slain all Forsaken and proven yourself worthy. The gates of Valhalla are now open to you – all you need to do is to let the valkyrie carry you there.
But worry not, you will always be welcome here in the tenth world, should you wish to return.
irish:
Bhuel a dhéanamh, laoch!
Ar deireadh fada, tá tú slain gach Forsaken agus cruthaithe tú féin fiú. Is iad na geataí de Valhalla ar oscailt anois chun tú - go léir is gá duit a dhéanamh ná a ligean ar an valkyrie a dhéanamh tú ann.
Ach ní imní ort, beidh tú i gcónaí fáilte a chur roimh anseo sa domhan deichiú, ba chóir duit gur mian leat filleadh.

english:
You have fought well, warrior.
Thanks to you, the Forsaken are no more, and this world can once again be reunited with the rest of Yggdrasil. But that is a story for another time! For now, you ought to claim your reward in Valhalla, don't you think?
irish:
Tá tú throid go maith, laoch.
A bhuíochas sin duit, níl an Forsaken níos mó, agus is féidir an domhan seo a athaonad arís leis an gcuid eile de Yggdrasil. Ach is é sin scéal ar feadh tréimhse eile! Chun anois, ba chóir duit do luaíocht a éileamh i Valhalla, ná smaoinigh tú?

english: And so the saga comes to an end...
irish: Agus mar sin tagann an saga chun deiridh...

english: It is not just a dragon's breath that burns bright, but its very essence as well. One can harness it, with enough skill and patience...
irish: Níl sé ach anáil Dragon a dhónn geal, ach a bunúsach an-chomh maith. Is féidir le duine leas a bhaint as é, le go leor scil agus foighne...

english:
You have found a snack, consume it to stave off hunger. Some food types are better for your health and indirectly affect how much damage you can block before becoming staggered, and others will fortify your stamina. Then there are also some that is all-around beneficial!

Be aware that before long you will grow hungry again, so try to always have at least a couple of different meals ready.
irish:
Fuair tú sneaic, é a ithe chun stáirse amach ocras. Tá roinnt cineálacha bia níos fearr do do shláinte agus go hindíreach difear cé mhéad damáiste is féidir leat bloc sula bheith stáirse, agus beidh daoine eile fortify do stamina. Ansin tá roinnt go bhfuil gach-babhta tairbheach!

Bí ar an eolas go roimh fad a bheidh tú ag fás ocras arís, mar sin déan iarracht a bheith i gcónaí ar a laghad cúpla béilí éagsúla réidh.

english:
You have found a snack. Consume it to improve your health and stamina.

Be aware that before long you will grow hungry again, so try to always have at least a couple of different meals ready.
irish:
Fuair tú sneaic. Tóg é chun feabhas a chur ar do shláinte agus stamina.

Bí ar an eolas go roimh fad a bheidh tú ag fás ocras arís, mar sin déan iarracht a bheith i gcónaí ar a laghad cúpla béilí éagsúla réidh.

english: Kraa! Pick their bones and break their domes!
irish: Kraa! Pioc a n-chnámha agus briseadh a gcuid domes!

english: The ward emits a strong aura which prevents other vikings from building things. It also locks all doors within its influence.
irish: An bharda astaíonn aura láidir a chuireann cosc ar vikings eile ó rudaí a thógáil. Glasann sé freisin gach doirse laistigh dá thionchar.

english:
Rumour has it that some traders have found themselves into the tenth world. If you find yourself in need of special commodities you might want to seek them out.

One of them should be somewhere in a forest such as this. I'm terribly sorry I can't be of more help... you'll have to keep an eye out.
irish:
Tá Rumour sé go bhfuil roinnt trádálaithe le fáil iad féin ar an domhan deichiú. Má fhaigheann tú féin i gá tráchtearraí speisialta b'fhéidir gur mhaith leat iad a lorg amach.

Ba chóir go mbeadh duine acu áit éigin i bhforaois mar seo. Tá brón orm go hiontach ní féidir liom a bheith níos mó cabhrach... beidh ort súil a choinneáil amach.

english:
With this tool you will raise mighty halls and towering fortifications.

Start by building a <color=yellow>workbench</color>. This in turn will enable you to construct other things.
irish:
Leis an uirlis beidh tú a ardú hallaí mighty agus fortifications túr.

Tosaigh ag tógáil líofa = buí líbhir / dath . Beidh sé seo ar a seal ar chumas tú a thógáil rudaí eile.

english:
I've heard that a trader was seen in an area not unlike this one. She is an odd character indeed, but may have very special goods for sale.

However, rumour has it that her stocks have been raided. She might need a helping hand, and you are starting to look fairly capable by now.
irish:
Chuala mé go bhfaca trádálaí i gceantar nach bhfuil murab ionann agus an ceann seo. Tá sí carachtar corr go deimhin, ach d'fhéadfadh go mbeadh earraí an-speisialta ar díol.

Mar sin féin, tá ráfla sé go bhfuil a stoic raided. D'fhéadfadh sí gá lámh ag cabhrú, agus tá tú ag tosú chun breathnú go cothrom in ann anois.

english: I have a feeling that this place could be more challenging than one might expect.
irish: Tá mé mothú go bhféadfadh an áit seo a bheith níos dúshlánaí ná mar a d'fhéadfadh duine a bheith ag súil.

english:
This tool is used for landscaping. You could say it is the perfect complement to the hammer.

Use it to clear the ground and manipulate the terrain. It is easier to create buildings on level ground!
irish:
Úsáidtear an uirlis seo le haghaidh tírdhreachú. D'fhéadfá a rá go bhfuil sé an chomhlánú foirfe chun an casúr.

Bain úsáid as chun an talamh a ghlanadh agus an tír-raon a ionramháil. Tá sé níos éasca foirgnimh a chruthú ar an talamh ar leibhéal!

english:
Consuming food is of <color=yellow>utmost importance</color> to a viking warrior, even in the afterlife.

Food can be found everywhere in the world, and a great deal of it can be prepared at a <color=yellow>Cooking station</color>.

There are three types of food; One increases health, one fortifies stamina, and then there's also a combination of both. Choose your diet based on your needs!
irish:
Is bia a thógáil de lí = buí líthirmeach / dath lí le ghaiscíoch inmharthana, fiú sa saol.

Is féidir le bia a fháil i ngach áit ar fud an domhain, agus is féidir go leor de é a ullmhú ag lí lí = buí . Stáisiún cócaireachta / dath.

Tá trí chineál bia ann; Méadaíonn amháin sláinte, fortifies amháin stamina, agus ansin níl chomh maith le meascán den dá. Roghnaigh do aiste bia bunaithe ar do chuid riachtanas!

english:
Consuming food is of <color=yellow>utmost importance</color> to a viking warrior, even in the afterlife. Having a full belly both fortifies your health and improves your stamina.

Food can be found everywhere in the world, and a great deal of it can be prepared at a <color=yellow>cooking station</color>.
irish:
Is bia a thógáil de lí = buí líthirmeach / dath lí le ghaiscíoch inmharthana, fiú sa saol. Ag bolg iomlán fortifies araon do shláinte agus a fheabhsaíonn do stamina.

Is féidir le bia a fháil i ngach áit ar fud an domhain, agus is féidir le go leor de é a ullmhú ag líthir = stáisiún bruithniúcháin buí / dath.

english:
Most items must be crafted. However, due to your recent departure from Midgard, you will have to recall the true shape of objects. Just pick things up and it will all come back to you, I'm sure.

My lesser brother, Munin, tells me one can fashion a stone axe out of <color=yellow>wood and stone</color>.
irish:
Ní mór an chuid is mó míreanna a crafted. Mar sin féin, mar gheall ar do imeacht le déanaí ó Midgard, beidh ort a thabhairt chun cuimhne an cruth fíor na rudaí. Just rudaí a phiocadh suas agus beidh sé ar fad teacht ar ais chugat, Tá mé cinnte.

Mo dheartháir níos lú, Munin, insíonn dom ar féidir le duine faisean axe cloiche as líofa = lí buí agus cloch / dath.

english: "Beware the approach of the Jotun army. You must meet them at their point of invasion and halt their advances, if you are to ever set the tenth world right..."
irish: "Bí an cur chuige ar an arm Jotun. Ní mór duit freastal orthu ag a n-pointe ionradh agus stop a chur a n-airleacan, má tá tú a leagtar riamh ar an ceart domhan deichiú..."

english:
Trying your hand at scrying the runes are you? I'm impressed, sorcerer!

Charms and conjurations will take their toll. If you wish to master the arts you must find appropriate sustenance. As it happens, the parts around here are looking ripe with all sorts of delicious new ingredients to gather. Lucky you!
irish:
Ag iarraidh do lámh ag scrying na runes bhfuil tú? Tá mé tógtha, sorcerer!

Tógfaidh Charms agus conjurations a dola. Más mian leat na healaíona a mháistir, ní mór duit cothú cuí a fháil. Mar a tharlaíonn sé, tá na codanna ar fud anseo ag lorg níos aibí le gach cineál comhábhair nua delicious a bhailiú. Lucky tú!

english: With this table you can record and share your explorations of the tenth world. Use the toolbox to record your progress and take a look at this large map to copy what others have explored.
irish: Leis an tábla seo is féidir leat a thaifeadadh agus a roinnt do taiscéalaíochta an domhain deichiú. Bain úsáid as an bosca uirlisí a thaifeadadh do dhul chun cinn agus a chur le breathnú ar an léarscáil mór a chóipeáil cad iad na daoine eile a iniúchadh.

english: Moulds can yield fascinating results! But it is not enough to merely fill them with materials – they also need to be hardened with the help of extreme temperatures...
irish: Is féidir le múnlaí torthaí iontacha a tháirgeadh! Ach nach bhfuil sé go leor chun iad a líonadh ach le hábhair - ní mór iad a cruaite freisin le cabhair ó theocht mhór...

english:
Raw ore needs to be refined in the <color=yellow>smelter</color> before you can work it at the <color=yellow>forge</color>.

To build a smelter you will need <color=yellow>surtling cores</color>. Search for them in the dark places beneath the earth.
irish:
Ní mór amh ore a scagadh sa lí = buí líthir / dath líthir sular féidir leat é a oibriú ag an líthir = buí líthir / dath .

Chun smelter a thógáil beidh ort lí = croíleacáin / dath buí. Cuardaigh dóibh sna háiteanna dorcha faoi bhun an domhain.

english:
The black forest is rich in minerals. There you can find copper in the ground and tin lining the ocean shore.

Now go forth and strike the earth!
irish:
Tá an foraoise dubh saibhir i mianraí. Is féidir leat copair a aimsiú sa talamh agus stáin ag líneáil an chladaigh farraige.

Anois dul amach agus an talamh a bhaint amach!

english:
Portals are great for fast travel between different parts of the world.

Of course, you need to build one on the other end as well, then give the pair the same name and they will be automatically connected!
irish:
Tá Portals mór le haghaidh taistil go tapa idir codanna éagsúla den domhan.

Ar ndóigh, ní mór duit a thógáil ar cheann ar an taobh eile chomh maith, a thabhairt ansin an péire an t-ainm céanna agus beidh siad ceangailte go huathoibríoch!

english: Be wary! The being imprisoned beyond this gate is mighty, more so than any other to be found in all of Valheim. You would do well to prepare accordingly before you venture forth to this final foe.
irish: Bí fainiciúil! Is é an á bpríosún thar an geata mighty, níos mó ná aon eile a bheidh le fáil i ngach ceann de Valheim. Ba mhaith leat a dhéanamh go maith a ullmhú dá réir sin sula dtéann tú amach go dtí an fóe deiridh.

english: Busy, warrior? I can come back later...
irish: Busy, laoch? Is féidir liom teacht ar ais níos déanaí...
Le do thoil teacht agus éisteacht.

english: Monsters will lay siege to your camp from time to time. Strength of arms does not guarantee you victory in these situations. Build a strong defense to weather out the storm!
irish: Beidh arrachtaigh a leagan léigear do champa ó am go ham. Ní neart arm ráthaíocht tú bua sna cásanna seo. Tógáil cosaint láidir chun aimsir amach an stoirm!

english: I have a tale or two to tell.
irish: Tá mé scéal nó dhó a insint.

english: Well done, warrior! You have found the sacrificial blood, the final key to restoring this realm. Now the All-Father has one last task for you – prove yourself worthy by journeying back to where it all began!
irish: Bhuel a dhéanamh, laoch! Fuair tú an fhuil sacrificial, an eochair deiridh a athchóiriú an réimse seo. Anois tá an All-Father amháin tasc deireanach ar do shon - chruthú duit féin fiú ag journeying ar ais go dtí áit a thosaigh sé ar fad!

english:
A shield allows you to block incoming damage. 
If your timing is perfect, the enemy may also be <color=yellow>parried</color>. 
Be careful though, if you block too many hits you will become <color=yellow>staggered</color>. The amount of damage you can block before becoming staggered depends on your maximum health, so if you plan on tanking a lot of damage you should eat food that increases your health.
Heavier shields will block more damage but will also slow you down.
irish:
Ligeann sciath duit damáiste a dhéanamh.
Má tá do uainiú foirfe, d'fhéadfadh an namhaid a bheith chomh maith líofa = buí r / dath .
Bí cúramach cé, má tá tú bloc amas an iomarca a bheidh tú a bheith color = buí líofa / dath. Braitheann an méid damáiste is féidir leat bloc sula mbíonn tú ag brath ar do shláinte uasta, mar sin má tá tú ag pleanáil ar tanú a lán damáiste ba chóir duit bia a ithe a mhéadaíonn do shláinte.
Beidh sciatha Heavier bloc damáiste níos mó ach beidh mall tú síos freisin.

english: Kraa! This should keep away whatever the sky might throw at you.
irish: Kraa! Ba chóir é seo a choinneáil ar shiúl cibé d'fhéadfadh an spéir caith ag tú.

english:
Deposit your raw ore in this furnace and it will melt away all impurities, leaving you with a bar of refined metal to work at the forge.

You will need <color=yellow>coal</color> to fuel the smelter. Coal can be produced by building a <color=yellow>kiln</color> and loading it with wood.
irish:
Taisce do ore amh sa foirnéise agus beidh sé leá ar shiúl gach eisíontais, ag fágáil tú le barra de miotail scagtha a bheith ag obair ag an forge.

Beidh ort líthir = buí líthir / dath nigh chun breosla an smelter. Is féidir le gual a tháirgeadh trí dhath a thógáil = buí lítir / dath agus é a luchtú le adhmad.

english:
Start tips: try to interact with things in the environment. Some items like stones, branches and pieces of flint can be collected and used for crafting. 

To open your inventory and crafting screen press $KEY_Inventory.
irish:
Leideanna Tosaigh: déan iarracht idirghníomhú le rudaí sa timpeallacht. Is féidir roinnt míreanna cosúil le clocha, brainsí agus píosaí flint a bhailiú agus a úsáid le haghaidh crafting.

A oscailt do phreas scáileán fardal agus crafting $KEY Inventory.

english:
I am Hugin, sent here to guide you in your travels.

The megaliths surrounding you are the Sacrificial Stones. They represent the Forsaken, which you must slay in order to ascend to Valhalla.
irish:
Tá mé Hugin, sheoladh anseo chun tú a threorú i do taisteal.

Is iad na megaliths timpeall ort na Clocha Íobairtiúla. Ionadaíocht siad an Forsaken, a ní mór duit a slay d'fhonn dul suas go dtí Valhalla.

english: Welcome to the tenth world, warrior
irish: Fáilte go dtí an domhan deichiú, laoch

english:
These magical stones were scattered throughout the lands by Oden as signposts pointing toward the ritual grounds of the Forsaken.

If inspected closer, this one will reveal the summoning place of Eikthyr, your <color=yellow>first prey</color>. He is a mighty beast, so you need to properly arm yourself before even attempting to defeat him.
irish:
Bhí na clocha draíochta scaipthe ar fud na tailte ag Oden mar signposts dírithe i dtreo na forais deasghnátha an Forsaken.

Má iniúchadh níos dlúithe, beidh an ceann seo nochtann an áit a thoghairm Eikthyr, do dhath = buí chreiche / dath . Tá sé ina Beast mighty, mar sin ní mór duit a lámh i gceart féin roimh fiú iarracht a defeat dó.
Is é seo an chloch Vegvisir

english:
You have been granted the power of Eikthyr. Use it in times of need.

Your next target dwells in the black forest. Go there, explore the lands, and uncover their lost treasures and resources.

The Elder awaits!
irish:
Deonaíodh cumhacht Eikthyr duit. Bain úsáid as in amanna de dhíth.

Do dwells sprioc seo chugainn san fhoraois dubh. Téigh ann, iniúchadh a dhéanamh ar na tailte, agus a gcuid seoda caillte agus acmhainní.

An Elder ag fanacht!

english:
Warrior, what kind of contraption is this?! It looks dangerous...

There is a grinding funnel up here, I wonder what you will put into it.
irish:
Warrior, cén cineál contraption é seo?! Breathnaíonn sé contúirteach...

Tá tonnadóir meilt suas anseo, Wonder mé cad a bheidh tú a chur isteach é.

english: Kra-kraaa! Warrior, is that a gleaming trinket I see in your grasp? Don it with pride, and let its power course through you as you strike down your foes. Once your adrenaline reaches its peak, you are sure to be rewarded!
irish: Kra-Kraaaa! Warrior, is é sin trinket gleaming Feicim i do thuiscint? Don sé le bród, agus lig a chúrsa cumhachta trí tú mar a bhuaileann tú síos do foes. Nuair a shroicheann do adrenaline a bhuaic, tá tú cinnte a bronntar!

english: Finding this place of ancient power is no easy feat, and those who have done so stand to gain a great deal! A word of warning, however – while the Forge may work brilliantly in your favour, it may just as easily shatter that which you seek to refine...
irish: Lorg an áit chumhacht ársa aon feat éasca, agus iad siúd a bhfuil déanta mar sin seasamh a fháil go leor! Focal rabhaidh, áfach – cé go bhféadfadh an Forge ag obair go hiontach i do fhabhar, d'fhéadfadh sé díreach mar shatter go héasca go bhfuil tú ag iarraidh a bheachtú...

english: If you carry too much luggage you will become encumbered, slowing you down and preventing you from regaining your stamina.
irish: Má dhéanann tú bagáiste iomarca a bheidh tú a bheith encumbered, slowing tú síos agus a chosc tú ó regaining do stamina.

english: You need to lighten your load!
irish: Ní mór duit a Éadromaigh do ualach!

english:
It seems one of the many bones this living ossuary hid in his belly was a Wishbone.

This bone contains powerful magic which guides you to things hidden in the earth. It can locate <color=yellow>silver veins</color>, but may also lead you to buried treasure...
irish:
Dealraíonn sé ar cheann de na cnámha go leor an ossuary beo hid ina bolg a bhí Wishbone.

Tá an cnámh draíochta cumhachtach a threoraíonn tú chun rudaí i bhfolach sa domhan. Is féidir é a aimsiú líthir = veins líthir buí lítir / dath lí, ach d'fhéadfadh tú mar thoradh ar taisce adhartha freisin...

english: Bonemass left you a parting gift

A strange edifice indeed. I wonder what it will attract. Let us just perch here for a while and see what happens...


Warrior, I am bored. Besides, it is not my job to babysit the likes of you long into the night... Just be vigilant and I'm sure you will be rewarded.
irish:
A edifice aisteach go deimhin. N'fheadar cad a mheallfaidh sé. Lig dúinn ach perch anseo ar feadh tamaill agus a fheiceáil cad a tharlaíonn...


Warrior, Tá mé leamh. Thairis sin, nach bhfuil sé mo phost a babysit an maith leat fada isteach san oíche... Just a bheith vigilant agus tá mé cinnte go mbeidh tú a bronntar.

english: A workbench allows you to craft <color=yellow>complex items</color> as well as giving you access to lots of more <color=yellow>building pieces</color> to construct with the hammer.
irish: A workbench is féidir leat a ceardaíochta dath = buí míreanna líthimeallach / dath líthir chomh maith le rochtain a thabhairt duit ar go leor de níos mó lí = buí píosaí líthithe / dath a thógáil leis an casúr.

english:
Kraa! Although severed from the trunk, I can see that magic still lingers in the roots of the old ash.

Needless to say, no weapon of your design will be able to break the bark. You need something better, fashioned by more capable hands.
irish:
Kraa! Cé go bhfuil sé níos déine ó na trunk, is féidir liom a fheiceáil go bhfuil an draíocht fós lingers i fréamhacha an sean-fhoinse.

Ní gá a rá, ní bheidh aon arm de do dhearadh in ann an coirt a bhriseadh. Ní mór duit rud éigin níos fearr, fashioned ag lámha níos mó in ann.

english: You must also follow Xbox's Community Standards, which applies in addition to our rules.
irish: Ní mór duit Caighdeáin Phobail Xbox a leanúint, a bhfuil feidhm acu chomh maith lenár rialacha.

english:
If you encounter unacceptable behavior:
• In-game: Use the built-in "Report Player" function (Options->Player List->Report)
• Outside the game: Please use this online form: https://valheim.com/report-a-player
• Via Xbox: See https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/family-online-safety/enforcement/file-a-complaint-on-xbox-app
irish:
Má bhíonn tú iompar do-ghlactha:
â € ¢ I-cluiche: Bain úsáid as an-tógtha i "Report Player" fheidhm (Roghanna-bhraise Liosta- ^Report)
• Lasmuigh den chluiche: Bain úsáid as an bhfoirm ar líne seo: https://valheim.com/report-a-player
Cóipeáil nasc leis an tweet Leabaigh an Tweet https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/family-online-safety/enforcement/file-complaint-on-xbox-app

english: Your platform privilege settings prevent you from playing on servers that allow crossplay with other platforms.
irish: Do suímh pribhléid ardán cosc tú ó imirt ar fhreastalaithe a cheadaíonn crossplay le ardáin eile.

english:
(Valheim – Xbox® Edition)
IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ THE AGREEMENT AT VALHEIM.COM/EULA CAREFULLY. BY DOWNLOADING, INSTALLING, OR USING “VALHEIM” (THE “PRODUCT”) ON AN XBOX CONSOLE YOU OWN OR CONTROL, YOU AGREE TO BE BOUND BY THE TERMS OF THIS END‑USER LICENSE AGREEMENT (“EULA”). IF YOU DO NOT AGREE, DO NOT USE THE PRODUCT.
irish:
(Valheim – Xbox ® Edition)
TÁBHACHTACH: PLEASE LÉIGH AN COMHAONTÚ AG VALHEIM.COM/EULA CAREFULLY. AG DÉANAMH, AG MEABHRÚ, NÓ A ÚSÁID "VALHEIM" (THE "TÁIRGÍ") AR AN XBOX DÉANAMH NÓ RIALÚ, DO CHOMHAONTAÍTEAR AG AN TÉARMAÍ SEO END-CHISTEACH COMHAONTÚ AONTAITHE ("EULA"). IF DO NACH COMHAONTÚ, NÁ ÚSÁID AN TÁIRGE.

english: This game has an autosave feature. Please don't turn off the game or console when you see the autosave icon.
irish: Tá an cluiche gné autosave. Ná cas amach an cluiche nó consól nuair a fheiceann tú an deilbhín autosave.

english: This operation failed because save data storage is full. Please remove unused save data and try again.
irish: Theip ar an oibríocht seo toisc go bhfuil stóráil sonraí a shábháil iomlán. Bain úsáid as sonraí a shábháil agus déan iarracht arís.

english: You were kicked from the online session due to the console going into Sleep mode, which suspends network activity.
irish: Bhí kicked tú as an seisiún ar líne mar gheall ar an consól ag dul isteach i mód Codladh, a fhionraí gníomhaíocht líonra.

english: Quickly tapping the stick towards the same element twice will interact with it.
irish: Go tapa tapping an bata i dtreo an eilimint chéanna faoi dhó idirghníomhú leis.

english: Quickly moving the stick towards an element will interact with it.
irish: Beidh go tapa ag bogadh an bata i dtreo eilimint idirghníomhú leis.

english: When scrolling through a radial menu with multiple pages, the top-most element will always be a back button.
irish: Nuair a scrollú trí roghchlár rada le leathanaigh iolracha, beidh an ghné is mó i gcónaí ar ais cnaipe.
